I wanted to take a minute to say **thank you** for supporting my campaign for Congress in Illinois’ 1st District.

Last week, you helped us meet our final Federal Election Commission (FEC) reporting deadline with a surge of grassroots support. Thanks to you, our report will prove that Democrats have the power to elect a progressive, pro-choice, pro-democracy Congress on November 8.

Now, about November 8...

**Election Day is just five weeks away,** which means it’s crunch time to turn out Democrats across our district and deliver strong wins up and down the ballot. Here are three ways you can help us do just that in the coming weeks:

We need to be clear about what’s on the ballot this year because there’s a heck of a lot at stake. Gun safety for our kids is on the ballot. Social Security and Medicare are on the ballot. The survival of our planet and democracy itself are on the ballot. That’s why if you’ve been waiting on the sidelines to donate, now’s your chance. It’d mean a lot to me personally if you chipped in $7 today, Derek. Let’s take a look at what Republican Kevin McCarthy said: He said Republicans want to “preserve our constitutional freedoms.” That sounds great. I’m for doing that as well. But look at what they’ve actually done. The MAGA Republicans cheered for the Supreme Court’s decision to take away the constitutional right to choose. And now, nearly half the states in the United States of America have either enacted a ban on abortion or are expected to shortly. In many states, abortion is already banned even in cases of rape and incest. Leader Kevin McCarthy talked about wanting a nation that’s safe. Well, let’s look at what Republicans have done to make it safe. They voted against virtually everything we’ve done to reduce crime and keep communities safe. The American Rescue Plan delivered resources to local leaders to keep their schools, hospitals, and fire and police departments open. And guess what? Every single Republican in Congress voted against it. This November, you have to choose. Will we be a nation of hope and unity and optimism? Or a nation of fear and division and darkness? I know the American people. I know your courage. I know your hearts. I know our history. That’s why I’ve never been more optimistic. Thanks, Joe Joseph R. name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: The most critical lawsuit for our children
body:
| | | Peter, Imagine that you've just been called into the middle school principal's office to have a "serious talk" about your daughter. You're worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been "educating" your preteen daughter \-- for months, in total secret -- about how to "transition" her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you "can't be trusted." That you, her parent, are not "safe." But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn 't you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it's no surprise that's exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter's California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who "groomed" her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law. ** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61479233:JeZnbtVNq:m:1:3334294963:D2DD101EA175D7B283A63BCF31E0E496:r) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica's daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called "Equality Club"? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably "transgender." _** "But don't tell your parents!" they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dea135f5d654c82a54a084125fb915d&_e=E8m36xz5P_R_yzFhvAQbSD2Mx7H03y9hnDdmzqM6lv5sYZ9ycqDNSBKxKqQpOFRi11SV8ZHYfcm9kdodERqsqcE-CdNNJhDZcLG0kkp__K8tg2Jh4pH-o9oyc5rqOmGrgijxgxtibKWLfwi18bFZ-QyJgz_mV5eU1LBewRaBDiJ7MQtKTonLi7ksVCgjBIQHNqqLg3eSnOJcrlUKYw_6gGTfxAF7Q7pjvfOANzHhAWM%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dea135f5d654c82a54a084125fb915d&_e=E8m36xz5P_R_yzFhvAQbSD2Mx7H03y9hnDdmzqM6lv5sYZ9ycqDNSBKxKqQpOFRi11SV8ZHYfcm9kdodERqsqU9juPycr0VvlN7emt1pYerWgkXbwMTSkDRa-NfSuh3_4WhOPWb3vNXix1xJLhqYi3xjUr7IxCTxpCh9nvN11pE_mT9tQjF5bnzmx8wMLYEEaS9ZlpVQMEkKp40sxsLK6OuVmoutQT8INjutAYxE7iI%3D)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

body:
So we’re working around the clock to defeat them.
|

Did you see this from _The Washington Post_ , team? | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51904436/370699691/-661765744?&amount=30&refcode=20221003.3r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA4ZTE3YzQ2LTg4NDMtZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xB26xuGSZurwqhomd90cTmo7HbFuFmT3PI8NhlyNTqE=)
---
If these election deniers had been in control in 2020, it’s very possible that Donald Trump could have succeeded in overturning the election. And now that Republicans are getting ready for a re-run in 2024, _The Atlantic_ reports that **they could overturn election results with control of as few as six states.**

That’s why it’s absolutely critical that we defeat ALL of these election deniers this November. To that end, we’ve endorsed Democracy Defenders who are running for secretary of state in important battleground states across the country:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51904437/370699692/-661765744?&amount=30&refcode=20221003.3r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA4ZTE3YzQ2LTg4NDMtZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xB26xuGSZurwqhomd90cTmo7HbFuFmT3PI8NhlyNTqE=)
---
From certifying voting machines to approving polling locations to managing the voter rolls, secretaries of state have a range of important responsibilities when it comes to administering elections. That’s why it’s critical that the people who win those races this November are committed to **defending our democracy.**

But with so many races happening across the country, it can be difficult to keep track of them all — which is why supporting organizations like the NDRC, where **keeping track of all those races is literally our job** , is such an effective way of making a difference.

**So with Election Day just around the corner, please don’t wait until it’s too late. Pitch in anything you can right now to help us elect Democracy Defenders and execute all our work across the country this November:**

The Democrats controlling our government have ruined our economy while our national security continues to worsen. And no matter how much I've tried to fight their corruption and power grabs, the swamp creatures keep looking for ways to punish me. They don't want me or anyone else standing in their way as they try to kill babies in the womb, offer gender transition surgeries to young children, or strip away our Constitutional and God-given rights in an effort to force more mandates and edicts upon us. **[I'm telling you - if I don't win this November and help take back the majority, Biden's assault on freedom-loving Americans will become UNSTOPPABLE. But if you donate $25, $50, or $100 and help me win, we can fight back and stop him!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61489025:6Lz9VtVNL:m:1:3331421248:9E3CE964FFF6BE72806845F1C572BB9F:r "I’m telling you – if I don’t

$50, or $100 and help me win, we can fight back and stop him!")** I've been telling you from the start - when the Left comes after us, it's only a matter of time before you're next. **Look what they 've done to President Trump and me.** First, the FBI pushed the false Steele Dossier to keep President Trump from winning. Then they hid Hunter's Laptop from the public by calling it Russian misinformation. And we all know how they raided President's Trump home under Biden's direction. The FBI had no problem ignoring the death threats I received just like they ignored attacks on pro-life pregnancy clinics. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61489025:6Lz9VtVNL:m:1:3331421248:9E3CE964FFF6BE72806845F1C572BB9F:r "Headline")Instead, the FBI has embraced their new role as Brandon's muscle against his political opponents. Just the other day, in their SWAT gear and guns drawn, they raided the home of pro-life activist Mark Houck. This shouldn't be a surprise. We've seen the warning signs like when they seized the phone of Freedom Caucus Chairman Scott Perry for questioning the outcome of the 2020 Election. Now they're coming after conservative activists... who knows if you're next... and it won't stop until we're either all in jail or silenced by their intimidation tactics. **[That's what's at stake for our country. Help me stop them by donating $50, $100, or $250 today so we can end this nightmare in November!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61489025:6Lz9VtVNL:m:1:3331421248:9E3CE964FFF6BE72806845F1C572BB9F:r "That’s what’s at stake for our country. November!")** They've been spending millions to see to my defeat because I will not stand for their Marxist mandates, or the indoctrination of our children. They are after me because I will make Brandon PAY for destroying this country. **And they are after me because they know I 'm the only thing standing in the way of them coming after you!** **[They need to see that every time they come after me, America First conservatives like you donate even more to help me fight back and win!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61489025:6Lz9VtVNL:m:1:3331421248:9E3CE964FFF6BE72806845F1C572BB9F:r "They need to see that every time they come after me, America First conservatives like you donate even more to help me fight back and win!")** And make no mistake, Grandpa Joe is just following a playbook he's been working on since he entered politics nearly 50 years ago. With each move, he gets more brazen in his attacks against Republicans. Biden has turned the FBI into his enforcement wing - to silence all those who dare oppose his radical Leftist agenda and corruption! It's all being done to ensure that the America you and I love disappears completely... only to be replaced by Biden, Pelosi's, and the Left's Marxist paradise. **I WILL NOT LET THAT HAPPEN!** If you value freedom, if you value your faith, your family, and America First values, then I need you to help me BIGLY! **[I'm talking $100, $500, or $1,000 donation to stand up to their tyranny and win this November.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61489025:6Lz9VtVNL:m:1:3331421248:9E3CE964FFF6BE72806845F1C572BB9F:r "I’m talking
$100, $500, or $1,000 donation to stand up to their tyranny and win this November.")** **We can 't allow Grandpa Joe or AOC to control our nation's policies. You've seen what they can do in two years to transform our country in their vision, and we can't afford to see what happens if they have unfettered power in the next two years.** Please don't let this be the end of my days in Congress or America as we know it. **[Help me fight back! Donate TODAY!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61489025:6Lz9VtVNL:m:1:3331421248:9E3CE964FFF6BE72806845F1C572BB9F:r "Help me fight back! Donate TODAY!")** Thank you. God Bless America.
Marjorie Taylor Greene
Congresswoman (R-GA)

subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6033%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=p6EOD%2bhTGCSM%2b%2fGPhe3zow&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86412%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YfAiLRXNmTMxXHwAe8DAyA&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86413%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8JCFSHanYcv6wF1BUDmg9g&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86413%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8JCFSHanYcv6wF1BUDmg9g&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to reach and teach millions has never been more urgently needed. That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. By responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey on Socialism today. Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education. Warm regards, Larry P. There is a war on women taking place in this country right at this moment.
| | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgk0vr16eaqsjh29sc7jrpbj22785a3p1c339f08_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3geco32cdh2bs)

Dear Friend, **There is a war on women taking place in this country right at this moment.** For decades, women have fought for their right to equal opportunities in academics and athletics. But in its push to radically redefine the previously undisputed definitions of “man” and “woman,” the Left is depriving women of some of their hard-won civil rights gains. Thanks to the current anti-scientific gender identity movement that the far Left is forcing onto our society, biological male athletes who self-identify as women are being allowed to compete in women’s athletic competitions. In one prominent example, the NCAA has allowed a biological male swimmer—now going by the name Lia Thomas—to compete in women’s competitions, outracing all the biological female competitors at the NCAA women’s 500-yard freestyle national championship meet. Far from being the only case of females being bumped off victor podiums by biological males, the Lia Thomas story shines a light on a disturbing cultural trend increasingly permeating women’s sports. You and I both know that sex is an immutable biological reality. We must uphold the scientific and biblical meaning of the words “man” and “woman.” In doing so, we will protect female athletes from the injustice of being completely driven out of their sports by biological males. Friend, if you agree that biological males should stay out of women’s sports**,****[show your support for women athletes by signing the NATIONAL PETITION right now—there is no time to waste.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2utu5s05u7ftu8aop2efi8f8dggi8g5k8u4r3v8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3geco32cdh2bs) **

This grave injustice is wildly unpopular amongst rational members of society... _yet_ most people are too afraid to speak out against it out of fear of extreme social criticism or political backlash. **One collegiate female athlete said that Thomas’ participation in women** ’**s swimming has completely ruined the integrity of the sport, and she finds it disappointing to know that the NCAA lacks the courage to do the right thing.** Title IX prohibits any school that receives federal funding from discriminating on the basis of sex. But instead of ensuring equal treatment of the sexes in all areas—including athletics—some schools are allowing athletes to compete based on what gender they self-identify with. Such a policy undermines the purpose of Title IX. **More importantly, it undermines the American way of life and the principles we stand for—we can't allow it to continue. ** [**Click here to sign the National Petition to STOP BIOLOGICAL MALES FROM COMPETING IN WOMEN’S SPORTS.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zao1fd0eqfpuvluhi2a8u30b530cqijlhlb9uejg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3geco32cdh2bs)

As if you needed another reason to support Maggie Hassan in her critical battle ground race... her opponent just told the women of this country to **“get over it”** when asked about a nationwide abortion ban.
That’s right: **“get over it.”**
I’m a writer – I know that words matter, and with this Don Bolduc told women that their dire concerns about their fundamental rights are unimportant.
And his words are reflective of his dangerous agenda: **Don Bolduc wouldn’t think twice before voting yes on a nationwide abortion ban.**
We can’t let that happen. We can’t let Don Bolduc become a Senator.
Our rights, our health, our lives are on the line. The stakes are just too high – **[words just won’t cut it, that’s why I’m taking action and throwing my complete support behind Maggie Hassan.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51907376/370707813/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1767-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NzYzNjYxOC1kYzQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1x4YYXhj78UbonF1wNfsSSrqj9tCa6h0AKvRG56sNa4=)**

# Good News from the Campaign Trail
Senator Tom Cotton of Arkansas has formally endorsed Castelli's candidacy! This endorsement comes on the tails of being named one of the National Republican Congressional Committee's "Young Guns." The Young Guns designation indicates the NRCC believes this race is winnable and they will be supporting our efforts.
# Upcoming Events & Opportunities
If you haven't donated already, you can do so now (see link in the header). It is "go-time" for this campaign and time for all supporters to get on board.
### Saturday
We need representatives to staff our booth at Gibsonville's Fall Fest. We will set up the tent and tables, but if you can take the early (10am-1pm) or late (1pm - 5pm) shift to survey voters and help spread the word about Castelli. We also need volunteers to wear Castelli shirts and hand out his business cards at the Bur-Mil festival. We do not have a booth there, but you can help out at other Republican candidates' booths there (and hand out Castelli materials). Reply to [Tina Forsberg](mailto:tina@castellifornc.com?body=Please%20include%20Gibsonville%20or%20Bur-Mil%20and%20whether%20you%20can%20work%20the%2010am%20to%201pm%20shift%20or%20the%201pm%20to%205pm%20shift.&subject=I'd%20like%20to%20help%20at%20this%20weekend's%20festivals) if you can help us out!
### Tuesday's Fundraiser
We need party helpers to set up and break down the Ceiner Botanical Gardens venue. If you can help Monday and Tuesday (decorations prep) or Tuesday at 4pm-5pm or 7pm-8pm (set up and break down), we welcome your assistance! Email [Tina Forsberg](mailto:tina@castellifornc.com?body=Please%20indicate%20the%20days%20and%20times%20you%20can%20help.%20Monday-Tuesday%20morning%20will%20be%20at%20the%20Castelli%20headquarters%20and%20Tuesday%20afternoon%204pm%20will%20be%20on%20site%20at%20Ceiner%20Botanical%20Gardens.&subject=I'd%20like%20to%20help%20with%20the%20October%2011%20Fundraiser).

Of course we would love to see you there! |

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: You can't be trusted..
body:
| | | Peter, Imagine that you've just been called into the middle school principal's office to have a "serious talk" about your daughter. You're worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been "educating" your preteen daughter \-- for months, in total secret -- about how to "transition" her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you "can't be trusted." That you, her parent, are not "safe." But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn 't you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it's no surprise that's exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter's California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who "groomed" her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law. ** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493652:6mc7WtVQN:m:1:3331421248:34C97A1A03E4104843ADEE38B15E299D:r) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica's daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called "Equality Club"? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably "transgender." _** "But don't tell your parents!" they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. Meetings were scheduled for lunchtime -- instead of after school, like other clubs -- so parents wouldn't begin to wonder where their kids were. What were they hiding?? If you've followed the growing nationwide problem of teachers "grooming" young, confused students -- you probably know some of the predatory tactics these teachers often use to manipulate vulnerable children into believing they're "transgender" or "non-binary." This case was no exception. In fact, these two teachers even let some of their secrets slip on leaked audio from a Teachers Association conference! Discussing how they managed to target so many new recruits for their club, one of the teachers confessed: "We totally stalked what they were doing on Google." **These teachers zeroed in on confused and troubled students and -- instead of helping them -- they further filled these children 's heads with lies and more confusion. ** [**Which is why I 'm asking you to make an urgent donation of $35 or more today if you agree with our lawsuit against these teachers, the principal, and the Spreckels Union School District.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493652:6mc7WtVQN:m:1:3331421248:34C97A1A03E4104843ADEE38B15E299D:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm a lawyer, and the founder of the Center for American Liberty. You may recognize me from one of my many Fox News appearances with Jessica Konen or other plaintiffs my nonprofit organization is representing in lawsuits against government officials who violate Americans' rights. Today, I'm asking you to join us in support of Jessica's case. It's clear that the defendants deprived Jessica Konen of her civil rights as a parent, that they conspired to do so, and that they inflicted emotional distress on both Jessica and her daughter. Those legal claims and more are at the heart of our lawsuit. I believe our evidence lays out a very strong case. But you must remember, this is a California school district and the defense's case will be funded by the government. And it will pay whatever it takes to defend leftist ideologies. [**That 's why, I hope you'll also consider making a generous donation of $25, $35, $50 or $100 to help fund our case. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493652:6mc7WtVQN:m:1:3331421248:34C97A1A03E4104843ADEE38B15E299D:r) The Center for American Liberty is a nonprofit organization, meaning we receive no government funding -- _unlike the deep-pocketed defendants in most of our cases._ Because of this, we rely on support from generous Americans who can recognize an injustice and want to see it set right. Our nonprofit status also means your donation is tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by law. We've seen evidence of this type of "grooming" at schools across the country. And it's not just in places like California! Dangerous teachers like this are unfortunately in classrooms across the country. Thankfully, the tide seems to be turning against them. Earlier this year, Governor DeSantis outlawed teachers from having these sexualized conversations with their young students. And elsewhere, parents have gotten involved with their local school boards to run for office and change policies that have put radical gender ideology ahead of student safety or parental rights. Those are political solutions. **Ours is a legal one.** And I believe that, in order to fully purge this predatory behavior from our schools, we need to fight this battle on all available fronts. Won't you please help us win this fight in a court of law?**[Join the fight with a generous donation of $35 or more so the courts, the plaintiffs, the defendants -- everybody -- will know how big the nationwide movement to protect kids has grown. ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493652:6mc7WtVQN:m:1:3331421248:34C97A1A03E4104843ADEE38B15E299D:r)** ** ** No parent should have to endure what Jessica Konen and her daughter did, and it's up to us to use the full force of the law to make sure no teacher is allowed to get away with this again. Thank you,

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message 👉
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493418:6l_87tVN6:m:1:3317145305:390F98609DF1C52E834330D4C3B3EC47:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493418:6l_87tVN6:m:1:3317145305:390F98609DF1C52E834330D4C3B3EC47:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493418:6l_87tVN6:m:1:3317145305:390F98609DF1C52E834330D4C3B3EC47:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493418:6l_87tVN6:m:1:3317145305:390F98609DF1C52E834330D4C3B3EC47:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493418:6l_87tVN6:m:1:3317145305:390F98609DF1C52E834330D4C3B3EC47:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493418:6l_87tVN6:m:1:3317145305:390F98609DF1C52E834330D4C3B3EC47:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493418:6l_87tVN6:m:1:3317145305:390F98609DF1C52E834330D4C3B3EC47:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61493418:6l_87tVN6:m:1:3317145305:390F98609DF1C52E834330D4C3B3EC47:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

body:

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned, millions of dollars have poured
into pro-abortion groups. Planned Parenthood and NARAL Pro-Choice
America saw overall contributions increase from $630,000 to
roughly $2.3 million in just three months.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWe-DdnhNY

Friend of life,

As someone passionate to end
abortion, you need to know what's been going on the last few
weeks.

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned,
millions of dollars have poured into pro-abortion groups.

Planned Parenthood and NARAL
Pro-Choice America saw overall contributions increase from
$630,000 to roughly $2.3 million in just three months. Every
donation represents another baby in danger of death by abortion.

Meanwhile, pro-life groups
accross the country are struggling to keep up as donors have
stopped giving. Too many people have viewed the end of Roe v.
Wade at the end of the battle, when it is just the beginning.

We need to activate 100 people
before midnight tonight so we can stay in the fight and reach
34,000 moms before it's too late. Will you take a stand with us?
Give $10 right now:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60874775:We-DdnhNY:m:3:2532013465:3FF7155070B4AB6DF3A6F6FFEDFF28EA:r

Friend of Life - this is a David
vs. Goliath battle.

We are up against a
billion-dollar industry and lobby with the financial backing and
support of the elites, the media, Hollywood, and higher education
- and Planned Parenthood and its allies are increasing their
spending and political action ahead of the mid-term elections.

Why?

Because they want to ensure that
Americans reject the Court's ruling on Roe v. Wade and expand
abortion nationwide, rather than end it once and for all.

Polls are showing that Americans
are increasing in their support of Abortion rights. The 24/7
media barrage funded by committed pro-abortion donors is working
and if we don't move quickly, all of our progress the last 40
years may disappear.

We have no time to lose and your
gift RIGHT NOW of as little as $10 will save babies from being
poisoned, torn apart, and suctioned from their mother's wombs:
https://give.liveaction.org/stand-up-to-big-abortion/

Your unwavering conviction and
commitment to this fight is why I have hope for our future. We
will prevail and overcome the horrific injustice of abortion as
we spread the truth, one heart and one life at a time.

For life,

Lila Rose

Friend,
With just five weeks until Election Day, we wanted to tell you about some of our recent endorsements.
Last week, we anounced that we had received the endorsement of The Working Families Party and the the Latino Victory Fund . If you haven't seen it, you can read more about the Latino Victory Fund's endorsement in Al Dia by clicking here [https://aldianews.com/en/politics/women-politics/latino-victory-endorsement?fbclid=IwAR2tcc0k8AGiK-dc80TAM97UXxIBIVxteD04YgaMkoP7KIHRuJqyPLIe8Uw] .

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
Each of the endorsements I've received is meaningful to me, because they speak to who I will be as a legislator, as a representative of PA-10, and of the American people.

One again, thank you!!

Shamaine

| Fellow Patriot, **I SHOCKED the Political Establishment**...and WON the GOP nomination for Congress in New Hampshire's 1st District as an **America First conservative**. My name is Karoline Leavitt.
* I worked for President Trump in his White House... where **he taught me how to punch back HARD** against the Far-Left's lies and smears,

* I'm born and raised in the New Hampshire heartland...where I learned to **cherish the conservative values** that make our nation _strong_ ,

* And, as a 25-year-old, **I 'll be the youngest woman _ever_ elected to Congress**...ready to win over the next generation to the GOP.

The Washington Establishment is NOT happy that I won my Primary. In fact, they spent _more than $5 million dollars_ in a smear campaign against me. Voters saw through their cynical, dishonest Swamp tactics on Primary Day...but punching back against these attacks has **badly depleted our campaign funds**. With less than 5 weeks until Election Day, **we MUST replenish every dollar...to ensure we have the resources we need to win this Swing seat**. That's why I'm counting on your help. **[Join my team by pitching in $25, $50, or even $100 to reach the next generation, WIN this Swing Seat, and send me to Congress>>](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zbt2psqve51jcsfsbou72ucurkoetqf40niue95g_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3ie8p34c5h2bs)** As the incumbent Congressman, Chris Pappas has a _huge_ head start in this race. He's got the **Establishment 's unified support**...he's stockpiled millions of dollars...and he has **deep-pocketed Far-Left donors in Washington** ready to come to his rescue. I don't have those types of resources. **All I 've had-since the very beginning-is the fighting spirit of conservative America First patriots like you.** In the GOP Primary, that was more than enough to put me over the top. But on Election Day in a Swing District like NH-1, we've got to do more to grow our support...and **make _sure_ we have the resources to put up a fair fight** over the next 5 weeks. If you're ready to FIGHT for this nation, send in someone like me who knows how to WIN. **[Pitch in $25 or more-any amount, big or small, helps! -- to get me to Washington >>](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zk97ur4i8tg4bdclpau36fnuv7l2f33cl917is1g_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3ie8p34c5h2bs)** | | | | [PITCH IN $25](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zt1k6p2sun5mgu5p4j9kueeuqesf2d8o0jelqutg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3ie8p34c5h2bs)

body:
Time is running out...

| |
---
| | |
I wouldn’t be reaching out to you today if it wasn’t vitally important.

My team and I just got out of a meeting where we went over our goals as we approach Election Day.

**I'll be blunt:_we are struggling to keep pace with the Democrats._**

As a result, Democrats are winning.

Colorado has a LOT of problems, but if we don't start with our kids, NOTHING ELSE MATTERS.**I am NOT going down without a FIGHT.** We've got to wake up and shed light on how dangerous it is to be a kid in Colorado right now. I am going to TELL THE TRUTH. I will be the voice for all the parents who have lost their kids because of Jared Polis' failed policies. ## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in June of 2021. name: Office of U.S. Senator Raphael Warnock
subject: Fighting to Lower Costs & Strengthen Affordable Housing for All Georgians
body:
|
---
Hi Neighbor,

I have some important news to share -

Georgians are being crushed by rent, and I've heard from Georgians all around the state about their challenges navigating rent increases and their difficulties finding affordable homes. This is unsustainable. **That is why I am glad to report that I recently introduced a package of housing bills to address these issues, and I am eager to share them with you!**
My first bill, the _**Rent Relief Act**_ , will offer needed relief to hardworking Georgians by providing a tax cut to renters who pay more than 30% of their income in rent. Additionally, the bill is drafted in such a way that it will ensure that these tax cuts go to those who need it most. While I recognize that to fully address the housing crisis we need to increase the number of available homes in our communities--which I support--I also recognize that Georgians need solutions now and do not have the luxury to wait several years for solutions. I have also heard from countless Georgians about how challenging it is to buy a home. Many Georgians have saved for years to purchase a home only to be priced out by wealthy investors and cash buyers--unable to catch up with rising costs. That is why I also introduced the _**American Dream Down Payment Act**_ , which will allow states to offer tax-advantaged savings accounts for buying a home, similar to a federal college savings account. My legislation would help hardworking families save for a down payment tax-free, making it easier to achieve the American Dream. Finally, Georgia has seen an influx of outside money from real estate and private equity firms looking to pinch every dollar out of renters and would-be homebuyers. I have been deeply concerned to hear about how families' rents are rising while their walls and pipes are crumbling. Most Georgia renters have no idea who actually owns their property, and this is especially true for properties that receive Low Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC). The LIHTC program is an essential federal tool that helps provide the necessary support to develop affordable housing in our communities, but information on these outside corporate owners is hard to find.

That is why I introduced the _**Housing Market Transparency Act**_. This bill would require state housing finance agencies to publicly report critical data--like who owns the property, development costs, inspection information, and when affordability periods end--on properties that receive the LIHTC to the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD). By making this information accessible, housing advocates will finally have the information they need to support renters and better protect the rights of tenants. This bill will also help us better understand the housing market, and create policies that will better support all Georgians.

**As a voice for Georgia in the Senate, I 'm focused on lowering costs on hardworking families in our state--****and this housing package is one of my latest efforts to bring down costs and save Georgians money.** Also, please know that I hear your concerns and am laser-focused on addressing them. As your Senator, I have used my role as a member of the Senate Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee, to shine a light on these issues. You can watch two recent Senate Banking Committee hearings [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16940.10687936.5986161.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.banking.senate.gov%2fhearings%2fpriced-out-the-state-of-housing-in-america&redir_log=637080391095573) and [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16940.10687936.5986161.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.banking.senate.gov%2fhearings%2fthe-rent-eats-first-how-renters-and-communities-are-impacted-by-todays-housing-market&redir_log=17960711755881) where I was able to amplify the housing concerns of countless Georgians.

I look forward to working with my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to pass this housing package, to solve problems now and prevent future ones. Please do not hesitate to contact me again in the future if I may be of assistance to you or your family.

Keep the faith, and keep looking up.
U.S. Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock

| This is official correspondence from the Office of Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock. If you have any questions, please contact our office [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16940.10687936.5986161.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.warnock.senate.gov%2fcontact%2fcontact-form%2f&redir_log=51402161759365).
If you need help with a federal agency, please click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16940.10687936.5986161.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.warnock.senate.gov%2fcontact%2fcontact-form%2f%3fpath%3dhelp&redir_log=904232600857435).

PRIVACY POLICY: Your e-mail address will not be shared with anyone else or sold in any way.
TO UNSUBSCRIBE, PLEASE CLICK [HERE](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16940.10687936.5986161.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.warnock.senate.gov%2fcontact%2fnewsletter-signup%2funsubscribe%2f&redir_log=564209011866492).

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482121:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482122:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "All
Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482122:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482122:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "JOIN TEAM
SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482123:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482124:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61482124:6F3aBtVNT:m:1:3339843426:96920C22274250585FFA9E0465C8180C:r "Step up
now!")**_

name: Chrissy
subject: 10 things you might not yet know about me 👋
body:
I know there are a lot of new folks who just joined our team – so I wanted to introduce myself.

---
| |
---
Derek,

I've been traveling across PA-06, speaking with our community members, and have had the opportunity to reconnect with familiar faces and have been introduced to new ones as well. I know there are a lot of new folks who just joined our team – so I wanted to introduce myself.
**I'm excited to share with you 10 things you might not yet know about me:**
1. My father came to the United States as a refugee fleeing war-torn Poland during WWII. A generation later, I am able to serve in Congress. I am here because the United States welcomed refugees and gave me a chance at the American dream.
2. His experience led me to want to serve – I knew that I wanted to give back to my community and the country that has given my family and me so much. So I served in the Air Force and as a Teach for America Teacher. This spirit of service has remained pivotal in my work for the past three years as your representative in Washington.
3. My experiences have helped shape my political vision of ensuring no one is left behind. I am committed to fighting for access to quality, affordable health care and working to build a robust economy for everyone.
4. As a former teacher, I know how difficult and important this critical job is, even in the best of times. That’s why I have and will continue to push for legislation that strengthens our schools, protects the rights of our teachers, and provides the best learning environment for our kids.
5. Our district is home to multiple semiconductor companies. As an entrepreneur, I know that fixing our supply chains was critical. So I helped pass the CHIPS and Science Act, which will bring more manufacturing jobs to Pennsylvania, and will get more goods on our shelves more quickly.
6. I worked with Republicans and Democrats to invest in our infrastructure because it's important that our community has the resources to succeed. As a result, Pennsylvania will receive $18 billion in federal funding to fix our roads, bridges, public transportation, pipes, and broadband.
7. As a mother, I will always advocate for Pennsylvania families. I've led the bipartisan effort to extend paid parental leave for millions of Americans, and I will continue to ensure that all families can have secure, affordable child care and improve childhood literacy.
8. I am pro choice – and I am happy that the House passed the Women's Health Protection Act, and that the Senate introduced the Freedom to Travel for Health Care Act. But I know that the fight is far from over, and I will continue to fight to protect women’s reproductive rights.
9. I've led efforts to lower costs on gas and everyday goods, helping to pass the Inflation Reduction Act. This is a major triumph for both our economy and our environment. I am proud to have voted to reduce health care and utility costs, combat climate change, and strengthen our economy.
10. Lastly, during the 116th Congress, I was honored to have been a recipient of the Abraham Lincoln Leadership for America Award. The U.S. Chamber of Commerce presents this award to TOP Senators and Representatives for supporting legislation that is important to the business community and the free enterprise system.
As a longtime resident of Southeastern Pennsylvania, I am dedicated to solving real problems for the people and communities of Pennsylvania. But as I face the GOP, that is coming after me as its TOP target for defeat, I need your help more than ever. This campaign relies on grassroots supporters like you to help us keep up our momentum. [**Derek, please help me win this race by chipping in today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51925523/370776824/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk714-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMmMzMmMyMC1mYTQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lY6T1XDm8aYwbG3yPvkN1vfG1yJ7hE_fiqOY7NQbkVw=)
It's an honor to serve you. Thank you.

There's work to be done,

Chrissy
| Chrissy Houlahan for Congress
P.O. Box 222
Devon, PA 19333

So I helped pass the CHIPS and Science Act, which will bring more manufacturing jobs to Pennsylvania, and will get more goods on our shelves more quickly. 6. I worked with Republicans and Democrats to invest in our infrastructure because it's important that our community has the resources to succeed. As a result, Pennsylvania will receive $18 billion in federal funding to fix our roads, bridges, public transportation, pipes, and broadband. 7. As a mother, I will always advocate for Pennsylvania families. I've led the bipartisan effort to extend paid parental leave for millions of Americans, and I will continue to ensure that all families can have secure, affordable child care and improve childhood literacy. 8. I am pro choice – and I am happy that the House passed the Women's Health Protection Act, and that the Senate introduced the Freedom to Travel for Health Care Act. But I know that the fight is far from over, and I will continue to fight to protect women’s reproductive rights. 9. I've led efforts to lower costs on gas and everyday goods, helping to pass the Inflation Reduction Act. This is a major triumph for both our economy and our environment. I am proud to have voted to reduce health care and utility costs, combat climate change, and strengthen our economy. 10. Lastly, during the 116th Congress, I was honored to have been a recipient of the Abraham Lincoln Leadership for America Award. The U.S. Chamber of Commerce presents this award to TOP Senators and Representatives for supporting legislation that is important to the business community and the free enterprise system. As a longtime resident of Southeastern Pennsylvania, I am dedicated to solving real problems for the people and communities of Pennsylvania. But as I face the GOP, that is coming after me as its TOP target for defeat, I need your help more than ever. This campaign relies on grassroots supporters like you to help us keep up our momentum. = It's an honor to serve you. Thank you. There's work to be done, Chrissy | Chrissy Houlahan for Congress P.O. Box 222 Devon, PA 19333 United States Emails are a crucial way for us to stay in touch with our top supporters; however, we understand if you need a break from political emails right now. body:
| | | [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=95dc09483a88419089406fa64225a73a&_e=95FJZobstLQcwiGu4zapSLWOOKsHBIqLYEuxtsilZysNKRpANIhOpcGEnBRqjzvuGy74zOnkUiB4aE1PmMTpL8_qyesstZ8LgxK50dXfmp756Ev1KCNnqUSDxFNpVx1Eeor5d4IcxcwNycae65e2ygWCtV7ibyVMcZ2QRTmK4o8AcjuPB1sq0xSK2uuzaJvn1-tb0r65JeYW2NSediEl4Q%3D%3D)

Dear Friend, **There is a war on women taking place in this country right at this moment.** For decades, women have fought for their right to equal opportunities in academics and athletics. But in its push to radically redefine the previously undisputed definitions of "man" and "woman," the Left is depriving women of some of their hard-won civil rights gains. Thanks to the current anti-scientific gender identity movement that the far Left is forcing onto our society, biological male athletes who self-identify as women are being allowed to compete in women's athletic competitions. In one prominent example, the NCAA has allowed a biological male swimmer--now going by the name Lia Thomas--to compete in women's competitions, outracing all the biological female competitors at the NCAA women's 500-yard freestyle national championship meet. Far from being the only case of females being bumped off victor podiums by biological males, the Lia Thomas story shines a light on a disturbing cultural trend increasingly permeating women's sports. You and I both know that sex is an immutable biological reality. We must uphold the scientific and biblical meaning of the words "man" and "woman." In doing so, we will protect female athletes from the injustice of being completely driven out of their sports by biological males. Friend, if you agree that biological males should stay out of women's sports**,****[show your support for women athletes by signing the NATIONAL PETITION right now--there is no time to waste.](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=95dc09483a88419089406fa64225a73a&_e=95FJZobstLQcwiGu4zapSLWOOKsHBIqLYEuxtsilZysNKRpANIhOpcGEnBRqjzvuIqx9BuC_tPUqEsLusaPyXWSJ5SDugKOZ4vqhlQPJd2a7oxBDgfzBUG1ybDpCtXS8ZAvDLwnAUgjLaLeghd_d6qNyh5slbc8OME3ewAWX-xr09pA5M8aMNW0xxW5fv2Bnp9pUIsQ26WgiaiApd9dqgA%3D%3D) **

Like a lot of people, I grew up going to church and had a relationship with God that wasn't especially strong. But as I grew older that changed.

When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.

They were very intentional to me in explaining God's Word. After some study and discipleship with them, they helped me begin my walk with Christ.

**Since then, faith has been central to my life.** I keep a Bible open on my desk, and read every morning from the Good Book.

Parents deserve to know what is going on in their children’s classrooms and should be notified about what support services schools are providing to students. Removing parental decision making from the equation is simply unacceptable. It has been weeks since I attended the regarding allegations of age and religious discrimination in teacher hiring practices, as well as student indoctrination, arose in the Greenwich school system. These are possible civil rights violations and Jim Himes has been completely silent on these federal issues. The Cos Cob school is within Jim’s home district and yet he has completely disregarded local parental rights and concerns. body:
I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Friend, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort – which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5m9kft5nbpet79n0lu45a15lue60i6uomm5u5po_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjg64o72cth2bs) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. I've got 15 minutes in between meetings, friend, so I thought I'd send a quick note to you about the state of our race.
All eyes are on Georgia, and experts are saying that I'm one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection. While it's worrying, my focus has been, and always will be, getting things done for Georgians and bettering our nation.
But while I'm working in the Senate to lower costs for hardworking families, defend voting rights, and more, my opponent, Herschel Walker, is busying himself with fancy fundraisers and rallies alongside Donald Trump.
Now, everyone from _Politico_ to _FiveThirtyEight_ reports that _this_ race could decide Senate control, and the GOP is coming after me as its top target for defeat. They'll do and spend whatever it takes to flip my seat; GOP super PACs have already launched round after round of attack ads against me.

body:
Today, I’m writing to let you know that we’ve produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our “Constitution 101” course [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6483%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=WXVpJABB4Dx7gVanVmaC0Q&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76042%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zK%2bI1QjaSYy%2b2e%2b6grB11Q&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76042%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zK%2bI1QjaSYy%2b2e%2b6grB11Q&sysid=1) I hope you’re having a great day so far. Today, I’m writing to let you know that we’ve produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our “Constitution 101” course, and I’d like you to have a copy. The course features Hillsdale College’s world-renowned faculty. It teaches the original design and purpose of the Constitution, the challenges it faced during the Civil War, and how it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and liberalism. It concludes by setting forth how limited government under the Constitution might be revived. “Constitution 101” is modeled after the course that all Hillsdale students are required to take, and this DVD box set is your opportunity to experience it for yourself. I hope you take advantage of this offer, and I have included a secure link for you here: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/constitution-101-dvd/**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76043%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9B%2f2oByL266pi9oLIAPdIg&sysid=1) As you know, Hillsdale takes no government funding, even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. So, your support is essential to expanding our national educational outreach efforts, like free online courses, designed to restore and defend liberty. As I mentioned above, supplies of the new “Constitution 101” DVD box set are limited, so I hope you’ll reserve your copy today. Sincerely, Bill Gray Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth--Defending Liberty since 1844

Right now, we’re running ads in Georgia, Arizona and Wisconsin.

body:
When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.

| |
---
| | | | | [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z2oa027u370vd3ua7d3ve84thha7nu7nf28dejoo_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjg66ob4cth2bs)
---

Like a lot of people, I grew up going to church and had a relationship with God that wasn't especially strong. But as I grew older that changed.

When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.

They were very intentional to me in explaining God's Word. After some study and discipleship with them, they helped me begin my walk with Christ.

**Since then, faith has been central to my life.** I keep a Bible open on my desk, and read every morning from the Good Book.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z8r7lmcmcittgqjjfsugj9cfa1b9trkij6hfvnuo_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjg66ob4cth2bs)
---

Like you, I am also confronted with a highly complex set of problems, and I need the wisdom to try and make the right calls. _**So I need my mind renewed with the truth of the Gospel each day.**_

Unfortunately, faith-driven judgments are few and far between in Washington. Our leaders act without moral clarity and the consequences have been devastating.

If we are to restore honesty, integrity, and morality to our government, __**[we must elect more faith-driven leaders.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z1g8v10jq1p4gj5rhk1gloa87up88u7vd6bddq80_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjg66ob4cth2bs "we must elect more faith-driven leaders.")**__

This summer, the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) released their latest plan for offshore oil and gas leasing in U.S. waters and included the possibility of up to 11 new lease sales in public waters. Even though the Inflation Reduction Act included offshore drilling provisions that harm frontline communities in the Gulf and Alaska, the administration still has the authority to decide where, how often, and under what conditions it will issue new oil and gas leases.
[_**That's why we teamed up with Earthjustice to rally 10,000 climate advocates nationwide to submit official public comments to BOEM. But with less than 24 hours to go, we're still short 1,000 people. Will you step up and be one of them?**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4339?t=5&akid=13103%2E53494%2E0LEPDH)

name: Candace Owens
subject: Proof that Hollywood is Satanic
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61498923:6-gz4tVND:m:1:3317145305:7BA60F0F27406ADBD38F5B21FFB0D973:r)
Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61498923:6-gz4tVND:m:1:3317145305:7BA60F0F27406ADBD38F5B21FFB0D973:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61498923:6-gz4tVND:m:1:3317145305:7BA60F0F27406ADBD38F5B21FFB0D973:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.
