name: Candace Owens
subject: Hollywood = Satanic Values
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61498874:6qP6UtVNc:m:1:3253819041:10C02364740D71BEFD662F7D266A1FB2:r)
Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61498874:6qP6UtVNc:m:1:3253819041:10C02364740D71BEFD662F7D266A1FB2:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61498874:6qP6UtVNc:m:1:3253819041:10C02364740D71BEFD662F7D266A1FB2:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

Fellow American, This nurse practitioner's story deserves to go viral. It's a devastating example of what will continue to happen if we don't draw the line for freedom. [**_That's why we're suing CVS_**** _._**](http://trk.readactnews.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzNjUxNjA3IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyNzctMDEyNGQ0ZmY4Mjk5NDQzM2JkOGZlZDg2YTBlNGU5MTciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMiIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHhsLmlzdC8xaDRkM3FxZHp5P3NyYz1SQU5PMzE1NjQifQ/VFXWSKz9iqkmD2SH8NAj_A) But I'm getting ahead of myself. Paige Casey is a young nurse practitioner. For years, she faithfully served her community, working as a nurse practitioner at a local CVS MinuteClinic in Virginia. When she was hired, she made her employer aware that her Catholic faith prevented her from prescribing or dispensing abortion-inducing drugs._ _ CVS accommodated her religious conviction for three-and-a-half years and didn't require her to administer any life-ending drugs. But then in 2022, they told Paige they would no longer allow her religious freedom. | | | _**I 'm not asking for money, just your signature.**_

_**[You may not know me, Peter, so let me share my story.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61481902:JW5LOtV7N:m:1:3346849603:A97903DAD702A4B60F53215868EA6751:r "You may not know me, Peter, so let
me share my story.")**_

My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of 3, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring _**real change**_ to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty earned as an active duty service member, and I **won**.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to advocate for all veterans, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

_**[Now, I need your help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61481902:JW5LOtV7N:m:1:3346849603:A97903DAD702A4B60F53215868EA6751:r "Now, I need your help to send me to
D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty
Murray.")**_

Murray has been in office for 3 decades and has done _**nothing**_ to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the _**failed**_ leadership they've been stuck with for _**years**_.

It's time for a change in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be neck and neck, and I'm getting nervous. We're finally closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

Can you endorse my campaign to help me take the lead to save Washington?

---

To victory,

Tiffany Smiley

Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61481903:JW5LOtV7N:m:1:3346849603:A97903DAD702A4B60F53215868EA6751:r "Rush support now to be a part of

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61481905:JW5LOtV7N:m:1:3346849603:A97903DAD702A4B60F53215868EA6751:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61481905:JW5LOtV7N:m:1:3346849603:A97903DAD702A4B60F53215868EA6751:r "Step up

body:
**Episode #4 ID BIGOTRY**

It is imperative that only legal citizens who are registered to vote in the state where they live are able to participate in our elections. The best way to ensure that only those who are qualified to vote are casting their votes in our elections is to enact and enforce strong voter identification laws.

For some bizarre reason, our current Secretary of State would like us to believe that asking for ID is somehow racist. Are the people of Michigan to conclude that Jocelyn Benson believes that minorities are somehow not smart enough to get a valid ID?

A valid form of identification is essential for any adult to be able to participate in society, and if someone in Michigan does not have a valid form of identification, that probably means the current Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson, whose job it is to provide valid IDs for Michigan residents, is not doing her job.

We must restore law and order and HONESTY to the office of Secretary of State and that's why I'm asking for your vote on November 8th.

I can't fight this battle against those who are determined to destroy the sanctity of our elections alone--I need YOUR help to defeat Michigan's dishonest Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson. Sincerely, Bill Gray Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth—Defending Liberty since 1844

body:
Dr. Oz *literally* killed puppies
#
I wish I was making this up, Derek.
**But *even more* news came out about Dr. Oz today... and I think you’ll probably want to read it for yourself:**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221004-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221004-7565&refcode2=7565_434096_uiK7Ni&akid=7565%2E434096%2EuiK7Ni)
**That’s right. During his time at Columbia University, Dr. Oz killed *hundreds* of dogs + an entire litter of PUPPIES!!**
You already know me + my team stand firmly on #TeamPuppy. Our pups, Levi + Artie, are basically spokesdogs for my campaign.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221004-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221004-7565&refcode2=7565_434096_uiK7Ni&akid=7565%2E434096%2EuiK7Ni)
**[Derek, we can’t afford to send a literal puppy killer to the U.S. Senate. Will you chip in $5 or more to help me send Dr. Oz back to New Jersey + keep him far, far away from any position of power?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221004-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221004-7565&refcode2=7565_434096_uiK7Ni&akid=7565%2E434096%2EuiK7Ni)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221004-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221004-7565&refcode2=7565_434096_uiK7Ni&akid=7565%2E434096%2EuiK7Ni)**
Every time we think Dr. Oz couldn’t get worse... he does.
This article said he’s conducted dozens of experimental studies that used live animals as test subjects. When he was at Columbia, he was accused of causing “extensive suffering” to dogs used in his heart experiments.
**Dr. Oz has killed HUNDREDS of dogs throughout his career, including an entire litter of puppies.** Every day this guy proves he’s just the worst of the worst.
**[We can’t let Dr. Oz represent PA in the U.S. Senate, Derek. Will you pitch in $5 or more to help me defeat him this November?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221004-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221004-7565&refcode2=7565_434096_uiK7Ni&akid=7565%2E434096%2EuiK7Ni)**
I know Gisele, the kids + I will give Levi + Artie a little extra love (and cheese) tonight after hearing this news... and I hope you do the same for your pups too.
Thanks for hearing me out,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

| | The Jewish community commemorates Yom Kippur, the Day of Atonement.

We pray together, we fast together, and we think back on the things we should have done differently during the year before. For the Jewish community, it is the holiest day of the year.

Yom Kippur is a time to unite as a community. This year, we can hopefully find a way to come together safely, which may mean making some sacrifices. We must ensure that all of us stay safe and healthy and look out for our communities — this will take constant effort over these next few weeks and months.

I hope you can join me in commemorating this sacred Holiday. To those who are observing tonight, I wish you an easy and meaningful fast.

Yours,

Josh Gottheimer

But Steve Sisolak - buddy of Gavin Newsom and Joe Biden - got his first big chance to respond to a crisis when the pandemic came along.
Here's how that went...
FIRST, he destroyed our economy. Over 90,000 small businesses in our state had to permanently shut down because of Sisolak's heavy-handed COVID orders.
NEXT, he made our kids suffer. Sisolak ordered that they couldn't even attend school without a mask on their face, only stopping the mandate when his buddy Gavin Newsom made the call.
FINALLY, he got caught in one of the worst scandals our state has ever seen. I've been named the most vulnerable Democratic senator up for reelection by NPR – so with the stakes higher than ever in this race, I've got a simple question for you:
What would you do if I told you how your donation of $25 today would help keep Georgia blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority?
Would you give $25, knowing it would keep the message of our people-powered campaign on TVs and computer screens and radios across Georgia?

Does America project unity, my friend? After a two-week trade mission to Japan and South Korea, I had many eye-opening conversations about how the world views our country. Our allies still believe in us, but they're afraid we're too divided to believe in ourselves. Is this true? The world is watching and looking to us to lead. The constant threats from China, Russia, and Iran are too dangerous to ignore. We need to find a better way forward and find peace through strength...
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=96b171ff8fa34eb89314b2433106dae3&_m=da26c635d2154cf69f0874e8984702e4&_e=l9cnvvrB6ZDZvnpOGnycY_7CJtAGA6lVGeReMUFpotR3Nea2bTR23jkwQbLzrdVtHGIkOHvYixm6IjZe6SHGgSZeHBmCpQoFIo2jQFY9QKG0O6DRnTrHFALnj4HehIbBDKY1MNzZ48vIef44Bkze1JLdOYBBdzEnshsIXkUSh4SpaDLHEbah4XLk-HewFzte649o8IZkN7OfzhrIx_94D0Gj8mvNSS0QFabBncl8f8TSXiO6wDijvcQdclN2YinNOPiQy7pXMpMS50XjfZxjPQ%3D%3D)

Our enemies are exploiting this weakness and **_An America United_** is working with our leaders to find common ground, dispel our politics of the toxic partisan rhetoric, and focusing on the issues that truly deserve our attention. Joe Biden is guilty of division. Donald Trump is guilty of division. _**And the American people are asking for better because they know we can be better. But you have a role to play.**_ Please help us continue the mission of ending the division in America. AAU is on the front lines, and we need your swift financial support to build this movement. clean_body: | | | Does America project unity, my friend? After a two-week trade mission to Japan and South Korea, I had many eye-opening conversations about how the world views our country. Our allies still believe in us, but they're afraid we're too divided to believe in ourselves. Is this true? The world is watching and looking to us to lead. The constant threats from China, Russia, and Iran are too dangerous to ignore. We need to find a better way forward and find peace through strength... Perception of our great nation is often shaped by the behavior of our leaders. And lately, that behavior is severely lacking. Our enemies are exploiting this weakness and An America United is working with our leaders to find common ground, dispel our politics of the toxic partisan rhetoric, and focusing on the issues that truly deserve our attention. Joe Biden is guilty of division. Donald Trump is guilty of division. And the American people are asking for better because they know we can be better. But you have a role to play. Please help us continue the mission of ending the division in America. AAU is on the front lines, and we need your swift financial support to build this movement. subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66a4e248bad84acdbbc797798324e083&_e=DKXt6nTR9I9czVKqDATi3CCY2Q8EQTpBd-lOowMWEwY_lfeY9pRLa1MaT51dlSRPxdqmoJQy221oZg6YWYgsMrXWVb-Tcm4KswglCRb_vmdP5GBywb02SmQfF79V0qRYFwsrsEi2QsuQ5Kvz3xHTdrNQjvSXj4i7XW6qDdEOsw7N1DyVHlwPmexGk6_agW9E209k_fJDvgeEHB9eW5u4zifDoEY7Bve2CG5zt4D6am-BZTQ5DUpC26ItkPpnZ74SJOvbasjooVZRPY4hvbxvZArUU3mvUN8bwMPZf-uZUykGZ7usCWrlDqg2EB7vlbH4QvQqjNefg5m0zFbThfgMgk5nJa_ROIIlmHkHeH1jVeszeEOXmURWe8CtbO89ChwGMMzxhWYZbCLeIyEPMOZjdz-huetHH4_AsYj02xzuCvIWucOuj6CqjlhL6oKxBIzn "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66a4e248bad84acdbbc797798324e083&_e=DKXt6nTR9I9czVKqDATi3CCY2Q8EQTpBd-lOowMWEwY_lfeY9pRLa1MaT51dlSRPxdqmoJQy221oZg6YWYgsMrXWVb-Tcm4KswglCRb_vmdP5GBywb02SmQfF79V0qRYFwsrsEi2QsuQ5Kvz3xHTdrNQjvSXj4i7XW6qDdEOsw7N1DyVHlwPmexGk6_agW9E209k_fJDvgeEHB9eW5u4zifDoEY7Bve2CG5zt4D6am-BZTQ5DUpC26ItkPpnZ74SJOvbasjooVZRPY4hvbxvZArUU3mvUN8bwMPZf-uZUykUkWGP5WCR4bgsyqrAZlkYAZc61Xu0y-Hf2ZT7hZ8poOzViFeYldvMRluC4s8raF8ZY6NCN4f___DcZyrNCUFP5o7e17iUKR0AJ1FrTPc7BSkqmM_eqVFzKFs0hiu_oSaFYHAaxBMZnU8B-XPaR2QP "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66a4e248bad84acdbbc797798324e083&_e=DKXt6nTR9I9czVKqDATi3CCY2Q8EQTpBd-lOowMWEwY_lfeY9pRLa1MaT51dlSRPxdqmoJQy221oZg6YWYgsMrXWVb-Tcm4KswglCRb_vmdP5GBywb02SmQfF79V0qRYFwsrsEi2QsuQ5Kvz3xHTdrNQjvSXj4i7XW6qDdEOsw7N1DyVHlwPmexGk6_agW9E209k_fJDvgeEHB9eW5u4zifDoEY7Bve2CG5zt4D6am-BZTQ5DUpC26ItkPpnZ74SJOvbasjooVZRPY4hvbxvZArUU3mvUN8bwMPZf-uZUynt6Qt0Eh4HW3NQq1IcQ3vQ8R4o-IMuwxw8SaiVgqprZrEN6EB1DmTUX2aQwr8REOk9TEHOZSGIYWP_xpk0hnIcMd6qHgokf-DWX7ejTyDxCO7yiiHEiH6RBUf4ev1AKgM9-r0XxlStkmcXyXntzgwL "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66a4e248bad84acdbbc797798324e083&_e=DKXt6nTR9I9czVKqDATi3CCY2Q8EQTpBd-lOowMWEwY_lfeY9pRLa1MaT51dlSRPxdqmoJQy221oZg6YWYgsMrXWVb-Tcm4KswglCRb_vmdP5GBywb02SmQfF79V0qRYFwsrsEi2QsuQ5Kvz3xHTdrNQjvSXj4i7XW6qDdEOsw7N1DyVHlwPmexGk6_agW9E209k_fJDvgeEHB9eW5u4zifDoEY7Bve2CG5zt4D6am-BZTQ5DUpC26ItkPpnZ74SJOvbasjooVZRPY4hvbxvZArUU3mvUN8bwMPZf-uZUyletLr7d4tX2ITM8tuF2EslmnsxwoyoHYbzAgbBw8MJ1e1OGu3bhrh59RZbmx8weHVq9Uk6_E7m-38Rv4dNPUZuRruRz2gcV2DkMFxwf_rsF-vBFMeYlNHOozJnLrc1GWUkRXJUywhuW56uBVLRfGgl "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66a4e248bad84acdbbc797798324e083&_e=DKXt6nTR9I9czVKqDATi3CCY2Q8EQTpBd-lOowMWEwY_lfeY9pRLa1MaT51dlSRPxdqmoJQy221oZg6YWYgsMrXWVb-Tcm4KswglCRb_vmdP5GBywb02SmQfF79V0qRYFwsrsEi2QsuQ5Kvz3xHTdrNQjvSXj4i7XW6qDdEOsw7N1DyVHlwPmexGk6_agW9E209k_fJDvgeEHB9eW5u4zifDoEY7Bve2CG5zt4D6am-BZTQ5DUpC26ItkPpnZ74SJOvbasjooVZRPY4hvbxvZArUU3mvUN8bwMPZf-uZUylPsQ2MuNwi5b42GqiNYSYxJEDgtpJU-JSEUMQHjnjwxa1LthOVB7chsFBS6i56aRVmFoiCxDGECrfIem5uq4iqNxhyZ3fqHgnQRzbXJEEgZhFViK__XES5EHPrqg8CcGK2affBoduoqayigE6YRmC8 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66a4e248bad84acdbbc797798324e083&_e=DKXt6nTR9I9czVKqDATi3CCY2Q8EQTpBd-lOowMWEwY_lfeY9pRLa1MaT51dlSRPxdqmoJQy221oZg6YWYgsMrXWVb-Tcm4KswglCRb_vmdP5GBywb02SmQfF79V0qRYFwsrsEi2QsuQ5Kvz3xHTdrNQjvSXj4i7XW6qDdEOsw7N1DyVHlwPmexGk6_agW9E209k_fJDvgeEHB9eW5u4zifDoEY7Bve2CG5zt4D6am-BZTQ5DUpC26ItkPpnZ74SJOvbasjooVZRPY4hvbxvZArUU3mvUN8bwMPZf-uZUykRYQ6i8QAaxvEA-gdIq0G6DLJUh5OcPp_ASfrd0FqadJ5Baw_gvyrGobISyq20A0XZD23qUFNcHMeBIZ7UyRDcbdDYYzKQxx9Hix2-OuUKN6UF_X6hVAZeH91XgHyDwr98_e1euJmq_1FVDKZqKDGe "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

Friend,

I hate that it's come to this, but our campaign is in a tough situation. I know you've probably already heard, but without winning Ohio, it's a done deal that Democrats will control the U.S. Senate Majority. **There are a couple of things that you need to know.**
* **We 're losing right now in the polls.**

body:
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Friend, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=39f57655ec8c42858b3b7034dd5fcdd8&_e=s2gJtOSmgTG5yQi0pVTLX5OVLyFZiCiFIEMwadaHS44lt3rD_QE_0ZwbEXG2RgE-DQfMSFjJ_xOpHB_c2jeICYgdaKDOMyNnge6bzH20gg9RTFJIsePLVF1SR2rIRTUPqmxd5j17dU0oREldv7m1aHndReRfXLFZK2LomPShlCQiEJvLtBKKUyQxF_1s-wTvFKFT-N2nPc7X7-5RTRmL-bCZc1JLqig3rn0oKc0r3gZBDqPPFJLE_n3Cx-w4_BbjdODTnhH0beR-zNgxSXNuSKd0tbkvEBgL0rgY-zwD6PdUay7QJb0-pu7OVVJ5FNgwaygPFbFP4_qmwIwKwAdP-3mDAwVkax6hNQvUPrHFmZA%3D) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in - by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=39f57655ec8c42858b3b7034dd5fcdd8&_e=s2gJtOSmgTG5yQi0pVTLX5OVLyFZiCiFIEMwadaHS44lt3rD_QE_0ZwbEXG2RgE-DQfMSFjJ_xOpHB_c2jeICYgdaKDOMyNnge6bzH20gg9RTFJIsePLVF1SR2rIRTUPqmxd5j17dU0oREldv7m1aHndReRfXLFZK2LomPShlCQiEJvLtBKKUyQxF_1s-wTvFKFT-N2nPc7X7-5RTRmL-SSiIKsfyc5tnpXX438chgbsVj3BAhhwQI7d18fyKA_fKNYuBWaXIPMqgN5lMxjqDhA8d5kYwoPxyda6PXnq2f0k3P6HMdB6DVKZ6_BdX8L603OMLEMuQp23kmafggCuKPp5Km4xQIqvVkZdueaHwNw%3D) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. Peter — When my colleagues elected me to be Speaker of the Oregon House, I pledged to take action on our state’s biggest challenges. And I did. As your Governor, I will do the same. **And right now, we have some big problems to fix.** Homelessness, crime, addiction, skyrocketing costs, and wildfires. We need a Governor who can fix problems and will **always be on the side of working people.** I’ll be a **force for positive change and deliver results.** As Governor, I will:
* Take on our homelessness crisis by **increasing street outreach teams, expanding managed shelters, improving access to mental health services, and building more housing.**

* **Fight back against the drug cartels** in Oregon and deliver on our promise to **expand access to addiction treatment and recovery services statewide.**

* Defend and expand access to **reproductive health care.**

* Work to **reduce gun violence** by increasing the age to buy assault weapons from 18 to 21.

* Make sure our schools **fund career and technical education, improve graduation rates, and support student mental health.**

* **Fight climate change** and create good-paying jobs in clean energy.

But first, I need your help to win this race. clean_body: | Peter — When my colleagues elected me to be Speaker of the Oregon House, I pledged to take action on our state’s biggest challenges. And I did. As your Governor, I will do the same. And right now, we have some big problems to fix. Homelessness, crime, addiction, skyrocketing costs, and wildfires. We need a Governor who can fix problems and will always be on the side of working people. I’ll be a force for positive change and deliver results. As Governor, I will: Take on our homelessness crisis by increasing street outreach teams, expanding managed shelters, improving access to mental health services, and building more housing. Fight back against the drug cartels in Oregon and deliver on our promise to expand access to addiction treatment and recovery services statewide. Defend and expand access to reproductive health care. Work to reduce gun violence by increasing the age to buy assault weapons from 18 to 21. Make sure our schools fund career and technical education, improve graduation rates, and support student mental health. Fight climate change and create good-paying jobs in clean energy. But first, I need your help to win this race. I’m up against two conservative opponents who want to push Oregon to the far-right, and my next debate is TONIGHT in Portland. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = With you on my team, I know we can get things done. Please, we have the power to stop them, but only if we act right now.

Thank you, and God Bless.

Richard Grenell

I want to take this time to reflect on why I decided to dedicate my life to serving the people of Pennsylvania.

Hey Derek, It’s Austin Davis here, Democratic nominee for Lieutenant Governor and Josh Shapiro’s running mate. I’m reaching out because it’s a special day for me: my birthday! I want to take this time to reflect on why I decided to dedicate my life to serving the people of Pennsylvania. I grew up as the son of a hairdresser and a union bus driver in McKeesport. My parents showed me how important it is to support working class families, and to make sure everyone gets a fair shot. My local community taught me the importance of togetherness, and what it means to look out for one another. That’s why when I saw a shooting in my neighborhood, I decided to dedicate my life to public service. **Hageman welcomes Rep. Jason Smith (MO-8) to Wyoming to talk energy & small business**
---
---
_Harriet Hageman and Rep. Jason Smith (center) visited Casper and Gillette to talk about energy and small business issues_
---
Harriet Hageman, Republican nominee for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, this week welcomed Rep. Jason Smith (MO-8) to the state to discuss methods to protect energy industries and small businesses from the radical policies of the Biden administration. Hageman took Smith to Casper and Gillette to meet with energy leaders and local employers. They were joined by state Representatives John Bear, Chip Neiman, and Cyrus Western.
“This is the kind of relationship I am already building with my future colleagues in Congress, so that we can highlight and benefit Wyoming industries and the people who work in them,” Hageman said. “I’m grateful for Congressman Smith’s willingness to visit Wyoming to learn more about our issues, where we share concerns, and how we can work together to restore economic vitality. When I’m in Congress, I will fight for Wyoming like this every day.”
Hageman and Smith met with oil, gas, coal, and uranium leaders, while also speaking with crypto and small business entrepreneurs. The two toured the Belle Ayr Mine in Gillette to discuss rail issues, Black Lung tax, and problems businesses encounter with federal agencies.
Smith is the ranking member of the House Committee on the Budget and also serves on the Ways and Means Committee.

clean_body: Protecting and expanding our congressional majorities must be a top priority. | | Derek: With a Democratic Congress fighting alongside Joe and Kamala, we’ve made historic progress for working people and families. We can’t stop that momentum now -- too much is at stake. That’s why protecting and expanding our congressional majorities is our top priority, especially as we approach Election Day. It doesn’t look like you’ve donated yet this year, so can I count on you to chip in $7 to help the DNC continue electing Democrats at all levels nationwide? We’ve already made tremendous progress together, but this November, some of Joe’s crucial partners in the House and Senate are on the ballot. If we want to keep making progress for families across this country, we have to make sure they win in November. We can’t do that without you. With only 35 days left, Democrats are entering the most important stretch of this campaign. We need to ensure these candidates at all levels of government have every necessary resource to win. But first, I hope you’ll hear me out. I first ran for election when abortion was illegal in almost every state, and I saw the needless agony and death that it caused. By the time I was elected to Congress, _Roe v. Wade_ was decided. Yet still, almost every month for more than thirty years, I had to stand on the floor of the House and then the Senate, strongly defending the right to privacy and safe health care. These debates were brutal. But I was proud to be part of a pro-choice caucus that did not allow the loss of this critical right. Sadly, now I see our country doing what it has never done before: Taking away a right that we have had for fifty years! I have been a witness and a participant in the battle to protect abortion rights, and I can tell you personally: It’s a frightening time and we must wake up, step up, and fight back. The Supreme Court’s recent _Dobbs_ ruling gave the power over our bodies to state legislators and governors. It’s outrageous! Recently, I saw a TV segment where a young Republican state legislator pontificated proudly on his anti-abortion theories of reproduction. I’m reaching out today with an important message. | | | | | Hi: It’s former Senator Barbara Boxer from California, asking you to and stand with me against the dangerous right wing attack on reproductive health care. But first, I hope you’ll hear me out. I first ran for election when abortion was illegal in almost every state, and I saw the needless agony and death that it caused. By the time I was elected to Congress, Roe v. Wade was decided. Yet still, almost every month for more than thirty years, I had to stand on the floor of the House and then the Senate, strongly defending the right to privacy and safe health care. These debates were brutal. But I was proud to be part of a pro-choice caucus that did not allow the loss of this critical right. Sadly, now I see our country doing what it has never done before: Taking away a right that we have had for fifty years! I have been a witness and a participant in the battle to protect abortion rights, and I can tell you personally: It’s a frightening time and we must wake up, step up, and fight back. The Supreme Court’s recent Dobbs ruling gave the power over our bodies to state legislators and governors. It’s outrageous! Recently, I saw a TV segment where a young Republican state legislator pontificated proudly on his anti-abortion theories of reproduction. Really? | | | Peter,

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So, they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me.
And that is why I decided to run for re-election.

It’s absolutely critical that we kickstart October with a huge outpouring of grassroots support.

---
| There’s a term in politics used to describe a last-minute momentum shift in the weeks leading up to a big election—something that can completely flip a race on its head.

It’s called an **October Surprise** , and since JD and I are basically tied, anything that comes out of left field could ultimately decide who controls the Senate in November.

_That’s why it’s absolutely critical that we kickstart October with a huge outpouring of grassroots support._

[_**Can I count on you to kick in $5 ASAP so we can stockpile resources and avoid any October pitfalls that might take the wind out of our sails? **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

subject: The Vermont I love
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Phil Scott for Vermont, Glen Wright, Treasurer,
body:
A pause in the election cycle. | | |
---
| | Friend,
---
| In the midst of this election cycle, with ballots in the mail and campaigns well underway, it’s easy to focus on all that’s wrong in the world. **Vermonters have endured a lot over the last couple of years. A once-in-a-century pandemic, national inflation and economic instability, and campaigns, politicians and the national media highlighting a never-ending stream of crises of the day**. This is enough to discourage even the most optimistic among us. _**But I still have hope. And it’s because I’ve seen what Vermonters can accomplish when we work together and how our brave little state can light the way for the entire nation. **_ I’ve seen Vermont at its very best when the circumstances are dire. During Tropical Storm Irene, I saw communities rebuild, feed, house, and take care of their neighbors. And during the pandemic, we watched as Vermonters listened to the science, followed the data, and came together for the greater good. But more importantly, I’m seeing this every day as we recover. I watch as downtowns like Barre, Springfield, Rutland, St. Albans, and others take advantage of federal and state grants to get the infrastructure improvements they need. I’ve seen Vermonters welcome refugees from war-torn countries and new immigrants hoping to make this great state their home. I’ve been proud of the community leaders, non-profits, and everyday people who work with us to make their communities a little better every day. **No matter what we do in Montpelier – what we tweet, post, or use as the daily sound byte – it's the hardworking people we serve who make their communities stronger. ** Our record investments in housing, community development, climate change, and more are only made better by the communities they impact. Every day – even as we work to make this state better for everyone – I'm reminded of how fortunate I am to be surrounded by the people of Vermont. So, thank you! Sincerely, Gov. Phil

body:

---
| | Peter, Are there any sane Democrats left who will call out Joe Biden for his insults? He is calling every conservative American a "semi-fascist." He's threatening to use the might of the federal government to murder Republicans. And not one member of the political establishment - including my opponent - will stand up to him. They always agree with everything Joe Biden says because everything he does keeps THEM in power. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH. It's time to fight back and make the government work FOR THE PEOPLE. Not against us!**__**_[**Are you with me?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501207:6xNMrXV8N:m:1:3253819041:465AC850FA53135CDC2C50A85AA59CBA:r)_**_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501207:6xNMrXV8N:m:1:3253819041:465AC850FA53135CDC2C50A85AA59CBA:r)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I'm the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501207:6xNMrXV8N:m:1:3253819041:465AC850FA53135CDC2C50A85AA59CBA:r)
---
Together, we're going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me...there's a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I 've always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that's not going to stop now!_
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501207:6xNMrXV8N:m:1:3253819041:465AC850FA53135CDC2C50A85AA59CBA:r)

[ ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501207:6xNMrXV8N:m:1:3253819041:465AC850FA53135CDC2C50A85AA59CBA:r)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There's not a lot to do there, but that's where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that's what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that "BDE" that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress" -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501207:6xNMrXV8N:m:1:3253819041:465AC850FA53135CDC2C50A85AA59CBA:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. ➡️ **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **➡️ _HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **➡️ _SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **➡️ _SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501207:6xNMrXV8N:m:1:3253819041:465AC850FA53135CDC2C50A85AA59CBA:r)_
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501207:6xNMrXV8N:m:1:3253819041:465AC850FA53135CDC2C50A85AA59CBA:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501207:6xNMrXV8N:m:1:3253819041:465AC850FA53135CDC2C50A85AA59CBA:r)
---
Sincerely,

First, I would like to say a heartfelt 'Thank You' for your support and involvement. I am grateful to all who chipped in to help us finish the last quarter strong as we reached our recent FEC deadline – and thankful to all of you helping us ensure every voter understands the stakes in these upcoming midterm elections.
Because of you, we are beginning October in a strong position to stay on track to win on Election Day and offer support to Democratic candidates in tough races here in Maryland and around the country.
To fully appreciate the importance of this election, we need look no further than the Supreme Court. The Court's new term started this week and, even with Justice Jackson now seated, they are poised to resume their extremist rightward push.
The fall term will feature cases challenging existing precedents on affirmative action, voting rights, freedom of speech, LGBTQ rights, and environmental protection. The decisions will be made by a 6-3 conservative majority including Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh, and Amy Coney Barrett – the three justices nominated by Donald Trump and confirmed by Mitch McConnell's Republican Senate majority.
Trump and McConnell may not have seen eye-to-eye on everything, but they were in lockstep when it came to their drive to dramatically reshape our Supreme Court and the federal judiciary. Trump appointed more than 200 judges to the federal bench during his term – including nearly as many federal appeals court judges as President Obama appointed in TWO terms in office. And since federal judges have lifetime tenure, we will be feeling the impact of this for some time to come.
Senate Democrats have been busy confirming President Biden's highly qualified judicial nominees since we won the majority in 2020. But losing Democratic control of the Senate will end this work – and, along with it, any chance we have of preventing the federal courts from drastically revamping American jurisprudence.
It's been a long road, but there is still much to do. We need to fight as hard as ever over the next 5 weeks to protect and expand our majority in the Senate – and hold the House.
As always, thank you for your commitment to this important work!
Onwards,
Chris

I am grateful to all who chipped in to help us finish the last quarter strong as we reached our recent FEC deadline – and thankful to all of you helping us ensure every voter understands the stakes in these upcoming midterm elections. Because of you, we are beginning October in a strong position to stay on track to win on Election Day and offer support to Democratic candidates in tough races here in Maryland and around the country. To fully appreciate the importance of this election, we need look no further than the Supreme Court. The Court's new term started this week and, even with Justice Jackson now seated, they are poised to resume their extremist rightward push. The fall term will feature cases challenging existing precedents on affirmative action, voting rights, freedom of speech, LGBTQ rights, and environmental protection. The decisions will be made by a 6-3 conservative majority including Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh, and Amy Coney Barrett – the three justices nominated by Donald Trump and confirmed by Mitch McConnell's Republican Senate majority. Trump and McConnell may not have seen eye-to-eye on everything, but they were in lockstep when it came to their drive to dramatically reshape our Supreme Court and the federal judiciary. Trump appointed more than 200 judges to the federal bench during his term – including nearly as many federal appeals court judges as President Obama appointed in TWO terms in office. And since federal judges have lifetime tenure, we will be feeling the impact of this for some time to come. Senate Democrats have been busy confirming President Biden's highly qualified judicial nominees since we won the majority in 2020. But losing Democratic control of the Senate will end this work – and, along with it, any chance we have of preventing the federal courts from drastically revamping American jurisprudence. It's been a long road, but there is still much to do. We need to fight as hard as ever over the next 5 weeks to protect and expand our majority in the Senate – and hold the House. As always, thank you for your commitment to this important work! body:
Hello,

Today, I am honored to announce that I have received the endorsement from a fellow progressive, champion of the working class, and lifelong activist – **Senator Bernie Sanders.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51968444/370881874/-300263789?ms=em22_221004_endrse_engg_gq_act___KB_ettx&refcode=em22_221004_endrse_engg_gq_act___KB_ettx&source=em22_221004_endrse_engg_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221004_endrse_engg_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=m125id6URTnI4DEKrSMCIUkKYBaNTiQUCvLtV5yyH1VQKsXnu4myCL2CS5%2Bip%2FzooXduOVI5NiLgNBUJqg9qhuFO4ZlSg4uEEmAy5UWYSOG81z8rscrvtbM7b%2FT3ubzMAF09y3LmUNq2RQdgyK4%2Fdg%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDk5NzRjNS00MjQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nFSXUNIUMam6oAqQKziXyAdn86fAm6z-hoYDIlhg0Ds=&emci=254287c6-403f-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&emdi=049974c5-4244-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=2429742)
This endorsement is special. Like me, Senator Sanders has dedicated his life to building a better world and fighting for our communities and the most vulnerable. As Bernie would say – _**fighting for someone you don't know.**_

body:
Even one volunteer shift could end up making the difference. | | | **Hello, Peter! My name is Jules. I’m a hairdresser from Delaware, and not that long ago, I’d never even heard of DeShanna Neal** — a WFP candidate who won her primary for State Representative here in Delaware last month by only _24 votes_. I got involved in DeShanna’s campaign, honestly, kind of by accident. I’d never volunteered on a campaign before. In the last few years, I’ve been going to protests, I’ve been emailing my representatives, I’ve been making my voice heard on social media. But it wasn’t until a friend I met at a Black Lives Matter protest told me he was helping a State House candidate that I figured if he supported her, I probably did too. I decided to get involved. The first time I volunteered, it was... nerve-wracking. It can sometimes be hard for me to have conversations with new people. But I was given a script to use, I knew which points to hit, and I knew who I could talk to if a voter asked something I couldn’t answer. Soon enough, I was in my element. Volunteering on a campaign was so fulfilling for me.**I’d recommend taking the leap and getting involved to anybody — because even one volunteer shift could end up making the difference.** **[Will you join an upcoming virtual WFP phone bank or text bank? We have opportunities in important races throughout the country, and there are only a few weeks left to get out the vote. Sign up for a shift here to help elect Working Families Party candidates from now through Election Day:](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDN_AKdF4M0u5pGQ87M_sP-eRT82z4YLYqpLO_sDfE8BZjAVp8NHoAkcFib2yUB_6kW3OocWLZ9kQta_pN6jkldBoam8_4_ay_EHGWivhOwXYwOgepQIxh0fU4Z9xtvY_ubSbsVKrzquMd0ZY_7lb7vhwAqJQLWFet4M4cFmmPyc6uduJqlJK1ULPrQKZsxMOdI1A8WyNjAIQcSwFGowYstUDPeMsB1wl_KRxsBjj_j8XFP525ztH43stzUIETb3MgGBNWiBk1uh19RIk-fAj8qyoB03iflruEBZycDXB74t006K34trqhH4B0Rwhu3GavlkcU-J7bAX4b8vn_L_tBTdOyPN9wYnE1BiHvOJkk41C/3q0/JHpvMZRdT5-eEz-TYAdmoQ/h0/0N3TnCF5geStCEbXZA42iwnTZ1VibDAY5mxAnqQ4uuk)** **[Sign up](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDN_AKdF4M0u5pGQ87M_sP-eRT82z4YLYqpLO_sDfE8BZjAVp8NHoAkcFib2yUB_6kW3OocWLZ9kQta_pN6jkldBoam8_4_ay_EHGWivhOwXYwOgepQIxh0fU4Z9xtvY_ubSbsVKrzquMd0ZY_7lb7vh7TlGim6fZzz31OwWaKN-wK6jUuWYbBc5LjAJoG_ZUo1T9CHVNjVK8q3XaJltvRUef7O-Et7lm9nyB3g42J8_cbDGx4KU3tZVn5xVSy1f3rwKVPsusFxSbfixqFwF3KdkL-f342c2-LWRvO2mGJH7Ipqh4W4z8FgdXYjIDBJvtWLeXjIJJXCgW-f12wfn8VLI6HC6wDoecCF5JUQYM6P7g/3q0/JHpvMZRdT5-eEz-TYAdmoQ/h1/Ork5b5pmWPO3WLH7Apcn3AnJyeOaG0GM22y3VEHnCjE)** The first time you volunteer to knock on doors, or to make calls, or text voters, it can be a little scary. **But the people who you have conversations with make it so worth it.** I remember meeting someone we’d contacted before who wasn’t interested in talking at first, but then looked into DeShanna and was so excited to hear from us again. Our opponent had been his State Representative since 2008 — 16 years without a real challenger. Finally, this voter had a real choice for who he wanted to represent him at the State House, and he was making sure his whole family turned out and voted. Another time, right before the election, I talked to a voter who had some concerns about DeShanna supporting legalizing marijuana. He was planning to vote for her opponent. But I was able to answer his questions about what legalizing marijuana would actually mean for our state, and that one conversation changed his mind. These people I met (and others) got us some of the 24 votes that we won by, just enough to avoid an automatic recount by two votes! **When I say that my volunteer shifts made a crucial difference in this election, it’s not an exaggeration. It’s just the truth. Their voices counted, and so did mine.** The midterm elections are next month, and I know there are going to be so many close races like this one — races that decide the future of our towns, our states, and our country. **[I’m excited to keep up the work, and I hope that you’ll join me. clean_body: Even one volunteer shift could end up making the difference. | | | Hello, Peter! My name is Jules. I’m a hairdresser from Delaware, and not that long ago, I’d never even heard of DeShanna Neal — a WFP candidate who won her primary for State Representative here in Delaware last month by only 24 votes. I got involved in DeShanna’s campaign, honestly, kind of by accident. I’d never volunteered on a campaign before. In the last few years, I’ve been going to protests, I’ve been emailing my representatives, I’ve been making my voice heard on social media. But it wasn’t until a friend I met at a Black Lives Matter protest told me he was helping a State House candidate that I figured if he supported her, I probably did too. I decided to get involved. The first time I volunteered, it was... nerve-wracking. It can sometimes be hard for me to have conversations with new people. But I was given a script to use, I knew which points to hit, and I knew who I could talk to if a voter asked something I couldn’t answer. Soon enough, I was in my element. Volunteering on a campaign was so fulfilling for me.I’d recommend taking the leap and getting involved to anybody — because even one volunteer shift could end up making the difference. The first time you volunteer to knock on doors, or to make calls, or text voters, it can be a little scary. But the people who you have conversations with make it so worth it. I remember meeting someone we’d contacted before who wasn’t interested in talking at first, but then looked into DeShanna and was so excited to hear from us again. Our opponent had been his State Representative since 2008 — 16 years without a real challenger. Finally, this voter had a real choice for who he wanted to represent him at the State House, and he was making sure his whole family turned out and voted. Another time, right before the election, I talked to a voter who had some concerns about DeShanna supporting legalizing marijuana. He was planning to vote for her opponent. But I was able to answer his questions about what legalizing marijuana would actually mean for our state, and that one conversation changed his mind. These people I met (and others) got us some of the 24 votes that we won by, just enough to avoid an automatic recount by two votes! When I say that my volunteer shifts made a crucial difference in this election, it’s not an exaggeration. It’s just the truth. Their voices counted, and so did mine. The midterm elections are next month, and I know there are going to be so many close races like this one — races that decide the future of our towns, our states, and our country. \- Jules Thoughts? **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

name: Candace Owens
subject: Hollywood = Satanic Values
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501700:JCed1XVkN:m:1:3331421248:5C3FADA1E435EE003337B1B88160A354:r)
Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501700:JCed1XVkN:m:1:3331421248:5C3FADA1E435EE003337B1B88160A354:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501700:JCed1XVkN:m:1:3331421248:5C3FADA1E435EE003337B1B88160A354:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

# MEET & GREET EVENT TOMORROW
|
---
| | | | | |
# Ready to Fight for Maine Farmers
With the harvest comes Maine’s time-honored series of regional and agricultural fairs, offering our state’s farmers the chance to showcase livestock and produce. This week my family and I are enjoying visiting the Fryeburg Fair, a fine example of this tradition. But behind the hard-earned celebrations, trouble lurks.
---
|
---
Maine family farms are under attack by an array of challenges right now, and our “leaders” in Washington, D.C. seem largely unconcerned. Politically-focused, cynical calculations by America’s current party of power are only part of the problem, but misplaced priorities down there only make it harder for family farms here at home to survive – if not to grow and prosper as they should.Agriculture lives or dies in rural America, which too many in our nation’s capital consider terra incognita. Don’t take my word for it: ask Maine State Senator Chloe Maxmin (D-Nobleboro) who represents my Lincoln County town in Augusta. Her book “Dirt Road Politics,” which urges the Democrat Party to pay more attention to the needs of rural Americans, has been [sharply criticized](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=93b7f7d245&e=f8a0a76a2b) by her own state party.It is little wonder that the headline-grabbing question of PFAS contamination of soil is the direct result of a state program that, until recently, urged and encouraged Maine farmers to use what is now said to be contaminated sewage as fertilizer. Then in a stark reversal, and against the advice of the Maine Farm Bureau, the state acted to [ban](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=babd1d6e49&e=f8a0a76a2b) all biosolids, which have applications in farming as broad as regenerating soil and providing bedding for livestock.Earlier this year, Maine’s legislature passed a bill that would have required small family farmers to add collective bargaining to the host of existential challenges they currently face. To her credit, Governor Janet Mills [prevented](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=c19434a052&e=f8a0a76a2b) this farm-killing measure from becoming law.But that was only one dodged bullet. Unfortunately, the wrong-headed regulatory measures keep coming: both from Augusta, and Washington.Maine’s First District Congresswoman Chellie Pingree took a trip to communist Cuba several years ago and, when she returned, [announced](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=c15f95c4b7&e=f8a0a76a2b) triumphantly that the totalitarian state “has developed great organic farming practices that are well aligned with the kinds of small, diverse farms that have been so successful in Maine.”Hmmm. Things on North Haven, where Pingree holds court and her billionaire ex-husband [built](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=952dd541ae&e=f8a0a76a2b) the utopian Turner Farm on a bucolic spot overlooking the passing yachts, must be very different than in the rest of Maine.Tax laws that make it difficult for families to pass on their land to future generations continue to destroy the continuity of ownership of farms across our state. The mandatory shut down of the hospitality industry from 2020-21 was [devastating](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=63f1104b9c&e=f8a0a76a2b) to farms and CSAs alike. And soaring fuel prices leave farmers wondering how they’ll be able to afford to run their tractors in the coming harvest season, get their produce to market, and buy fertilizer for next year.While Pingree sits on two House committees relevant to farming, her various initiatives in the name of agriculture have more to do with the airy talk of climate change than throwing a lifeline to the small family farms throughout our district. According to a study by the University of Maine’s Cooperative Extension Network, the number of family farms in Maine [fell](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=ba077745ce&e=f8a0a76a2b) by 400 between the agricultural censuses of 2012 and 2017 – a 7% decrease.If the fear of being regulated out-of-existence were not so real, Maine voters would have had little reason to [pass](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=63584446f6&e=f8a0a76a2b) the “Right to Food” amendment to our state’s constitution last fall.One Southern Maine man who was recently forced to shut down his family’s farm after running it for a quarter century told me his labor costs had risen over 100% over the past five years and he was unwilling to pass those onto customers who faced the same economic pressures his farm did. Stories like these cloud the honest ambitions of hard-working Mainers who now struggle to make a living working the earth.Today, we need a total re-think of what is required for Maine farmers to survive, and thrive. The priority is not to put more acres into conservation easements but to put more food on the tables of Maine families. That means applying all our shoulders to the task of getting Maine’s and America’s economy growing again. Getting there also requires sending some fresh faces to Washington ready to fight for all of Maine’s farming families.

Her book “Dirt Road Politics,” which urges the Democrat Party to pay more attention to the needs of rural Americans, has been by her own state party.It is little wonder that the headline-grabbing question of PFAS contamination of soil is the direct result of a state program that, until recently, urged and encouraged Maine farmers to use what is now said to be contaminated sewage as fertilizer. Then in a stark reversal, and against the advice of the Maine Farm Bureau, the state acted to all biosolids, which have applications in farming as broad as regenerating soil and providing bedding for livestock.Earlier this year, Maine’s legislature passed a bill that would have required small family farmers to add collective bargaining to the host of existential challenges they currently face. To her credit, Governor Janet Mills this farm-killing measure from becoming law.But that was only one dodged bullet. Unfortunately, the wrong-headed regulatory measures keep coming: both from Augusta, and Washington.Maine’s First District Congresswoman Chellie Pingree took a trip to communist Cuba several years ago and, when she returned, triumphantly that the totalitarian state “has developed great organic farming practices that are well aligned with the kinds of small, diverse farms that have been so successful in Maine.”Hmmm. Things on North Haven, where Pingree holds court and her billionaire ex-husband the utopian Turner Farm on a bucolic spot overlooking the passing yachts, must be very different than in the rest of Maine.Tax laws that make it difficult for families to pass on their land to future generations continue to destroy the continuity of ownership of farms across our state. The mandatory shut down of the hospitality industry from 2020-21 was to farms and CSAs alike. And soaring fuel prices leave farmers wondering how they’ll be able to afford to run their tractors in the coming harvest season, get their produce to market, and buy fertilizer for next year.While Pingree sits on two House committees relevant to farming, her various initiatives in the name of agriculture have more to do with the airy talk of climate change than throwing a lifeline to the small family farms throughout our district. According to a study by the University of Maine’s Cooperative Extension Network, the number of family farms in Maine by 400 between the agricultural censuses of 2012 and 2017 – a 7% decrease.If the fear of being regulated out-of-existence were not so real, Maine voters would have had little reason to the “Right to Food” amendment to our state’s constitution last fall.One Southern Maine man who was recently forced to shut down his family’s farm after running it for a quarter century told me his labor costs had risen over 100% over the past five years and he was unwilling to pass those onto customers who faced the same economic pressures his farm did. Stories like these cloud the honest ambitions of hard-working Mainers who now struggle to make a living working the earth.Today, we need a total re-think of what is required for Maine farmers to survive, and thrive. The priority is not to put more acres into conservation easements but to put more food on the tables of Maine families. That means applying all our shoulders to the task of getting Maine’s and America’s economy growing again. body:
to take back our nation.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501633:6Ro7mXVON:m:1:3253819041:8E851023CCFDD03668D6A18CB727C519:r)

Peter,

This is Rudy. I'm humbly asking you to read my story and learn why I'm running to save the American Dream for the next generation.

_I was heartbroken the second I got the news of my friend and mentor Congresswoman Jackie Walorski & two of her young staff passing away in a tragic accident in early August._ **Her leadership and her dedication to serving others will never be forgotten.**

Jackie's drive and passion to ensure the citizens of Northern Indiana had a voice and true representation in Washington is one of the many reasons why I am proud to have stood beside her throughout the years.

**Today, I have a new opportunity as the new Republican nominee to carry on her legacy in the halls of Congress to continue her mission to bring true Hoosier common sense to D.C. I am honored to have the support of her family as I embark on this journey. **

**Look, Washington is missing leaders who are committed to protecting their local communities and fighting to restore America 's strength at home and abroad. As a business leader who grew up in this district, my neighbors in Indiana-02 do not have to worry about me putting politics ahead of their best interests.**

Today we are seeing Nancy Pelosi and her radical Left allies take our country down a road that will be unrecognizable if not stopped immediately. Every day we are seeing the Pelosi-Biden agenda place new burdens on hard-working American families.

This November is our final time to hold the Left accountable and redirect our country from falling further into the depths of socialism. The Democrats know the walls are closing in on them, and they're DUMPING millions into every race on the map. Unfortunately, new data shows the momentum shifting in the Dem's favor. **We need your support in the next 24 hours to help us claim victory! **
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501633:6Ro7mXVON:m:1:3253819041:8E851023CCFDD03668D6A18CB727C519:r)[**TAKE BACK THE HOUSE**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501633:6Ro7mXVON:m:1:3253819041:8E851023CCFDD03668D6A18CB727C519:r)
Peter, the election is less than 40 days away. I'm not usually the guy who asks for help, but I need your support ASAP to get my campaign off the ground so we can make Jackie proud and remove Nancy Pelosi from power this November.
**Help Boost My Campaign:**
