name: Ryan, Team Welch
subject: 5 weeks
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
Our campaign is relying on sustained support during this final sprint to take us to the next level.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1025%2E61531%2Ej59Ivj)
Hi there,
It’s Ryan, Peter’s campaign manager. As we approach the final five weeks of our campaign, I’ll be giving grassroots supporters like you weekly updates from here on out, and I’m sharing exactly why I’m on Team Welch.
**But before I dive into the details, I want to be upfront with you: five weeks isn’t a lot of time. Our campaign is relying on sustained support during this final sprint to take us to the next level. By making one gift per week, for the next five weeks, you’ll give us the certainty and the resources we need to make effective plans and to reach voters all across this state.**
[**Will you pledge to make a weekly recurring donation from now until November 8? This is how we ensure we have the grassroots power to scale this movement and send Peter to the Senate.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4466?t=3&akid=1025%2E61531%2Ej59Ivj)
[DONATE WEEKLY ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4466?t=9&t=10&akid=1025%2E61531%2Ej59Ivj)
---
I’ve worked for Peter since 2015. So I’ve seen the kind of person he is and how he leads with Vermont values—by valuing the importance of community, listening, and focusing on the solutions, not who gets credit. And, I know this personally, because Peter’s been there for me in good times and bad, which is exactly how he’s shown up for his constituents as congressman. He’s always there with a kind word or handwritten note because that’s just who he is.
But it’s not serious all the time—Peter is also pretty fun to be around, both on the trail and in the office! You know him as your congressman, but here on Team Welch, he’s who I like to describe as the class clown—always joking around and hunting for snacks around the office. It’s really never a dull moment!
Peter has worked for the past 15 years to deliver on some of the most consequential problems working families are facing, like lowering prescription drug prices and confronting climate change. But I see just as much drive in him to help Vermonters now as I did the day I started working for him. That’s how I know we need his experience, and his Vermont values, in the U.S. Senate.
Our campaign is so much bigger than just this election. **To understand just how high the stakes are, just think: Republicans only need one seat to retake Senate control—and we can’t let it be Vermont.** We know we must win here in Vermont if we want to keep the Senate blue. If our Republican opponent wins, our entire progressive agenda will be on the line.
[**That’s why I’m asking (if you’re able) to make a five-week commitment to our campaign with a weekly recurring donation every week until Election Day. Anything you’re able to contribute—$5, $10, $25—will be a huge help to reach voters in a critical race like this.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4466?t=4&akid=1025%2E61531%2Ej59Ivj)
[DONATE WEEKLY ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4466?t=9&t=12&akid=1025%2E61531%2Ej59Ivj)
---
Thank you so much for everything—and I’ll be in touch again next week.
Ryan McLaren
Campaign Manager, Welch for Vermont
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4466?t=5&akid=1025%2E61531%2Ej59Ivj)
PS: We understand not everyone is able to give weekly. [**If you’re able, and you’d like to make a one-time contribution, you can do so here.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4465?t=6&akid=1025%2E61531%2Ej59Ivj)

body:
Welcome back to another Russell's Roundup, your weekly source... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/russellfrysc/russells-roundup-104?e=7aa6ac5965)
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=a130247ae7&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
| October 4, 2022
---
| | Friends,

Welcome back to another _**Russell's Roundup**_ , your weekly source for the latest on Russell Fry's campaign to Congress to take back the House!

---
| **Hurricane Ian**
To the linemen who restored the power, thank you. To the first responders who helped people up and down the coast, thank you. To the state and local government employees who have worked around the clock, thank you.

Yesterday and today, I toured parts of Pawleys Island, Georgetown, North Myrtle Beach, and Cherry Grove with local and state leaders to assess the damage from Hurricane Ian. We have a lot to be thankful for, and there's already been great clean-up progress, but we still have work to do.

The Grand Strand is the economic engine that drives this state, and I know that Team South Carolina will work together to allocate the necessary resources to help our area get back on its feet.
---
|
---
---
|
---
| |
---

**Don't Forget!**
Sign up for your Fry for Congress yard signs [HERE](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=7c60815d71&e=7aa6ac5965). Additional details in the link.

---
|
---
| |
---
**In The News **
I joined Trace Gallagher on Fox News at Night last week to discuss how the Grand Strand prepared for Hurricane Ian.

Watch the full interview [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=e64dab7ec7&e=7aa6ac5965).
---
|
---
|
---
**Last Week **
I had a great time speaking to voters at the Georgetown GOP's Meet the Candidates event. With the stock market plummeting, the soaring cost of goods, and gas prices on the rise yet again, the economy was the #1 issue on everyone's mind. They're ready to vote red in November.
|
---
---
| | **WE NEED YOU! **
This election isn't going to win itself. We need everything you can give to dethrone the Democrats! Click [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=8a4c648fdc&e=7aa6ac5965) to donate.

**Pssst! PASS IT ON!**
Help spread the word of what Russell is doing here in the 7th Congressional District. Please take a moment and forward this newsletter to 10 of your neighbors, relatives, co-workers, and friends. They’ll be glad you did!

**COUNTDOWN TO ELECTION DAY!**
There are just **_35_ **days until November 8. Mark your calendars and get ready to head to the polls!

name: Team Padilla
subject: L.A. Times: “The nation needs Alex Padilla in the U.S. Senate.”
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
Alex Padilla is the proud son of immigrants and a proud son of California.
#

We're writing with some exciting news:
**_Our campaign has just been endorsed by the Los Angeles Times!_**
They said “the nation needs Alex Padilla in the U.S. Senate,” and called him “a level-headed and thoughtful lawmaker with a demonstrated commitment to improving life for the working class and immigrants, and who champions democratic ideals and institutions.”
Please, take a minute to read their full endorsement below, and then, if you can afford it, [**please consider making a donation to Alex’s campaign to help us get out the vote before Election Day in just 5 weeks.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22.YTGLMp&refcode=em221004-1-30&t=1&akid=1047%2E159979%2EUVepP4)
Thank you! It means a lot to Alex and to all of us to have your support.
\- Team Padilla
* * *
**Endorsement: Alex Padilla for U.S. Senate**
**By: The Times Editorial Board**
When Alex Padilla took over Kamala Harris’ seat in the U.S. Senate in 2021, he quickly proved that Gov. Gavin Newsom had made a wise appointment, stepping confidently onto the national stage at a moment of intense political turmoil. On Nov. 8, voters will be asked to give him his first full term representing the great state of California, and they should do so without hesitation.
The Democrat from Los Angeles is just what the nation needs: a level-headed and thoughtful lawmaker with a demonstrated commitment to improving life for the working class and immigrants, and who champions democratic ideals and institutions. You could say he has been in training for this job for more than 20 years, after being elected to the Los Angeles City Council in 1999 at age 26 to represent the north San Fernando Valley, where he grew up and still lives. Padilla moved to the state Legislature and then, in 2014, was elected California’s secretary of state.
As the state’s top elections chief, Padilla ushered in voting reforms that increased registration and voter participation, even while pushing back against the unfounded claims of election fraud by former President Trump and other GOP officials. In the Senate, he has continued to support election integrity and is one of the co-sponsors of the Electoral Count Reform Act, which would reform the process to certify presidential election results.
The son of Mexican immigrants, Padilla has also become an important advocate for immigrants and immigration reform — not in the performative way of certain GOP governors who have been shipping migrants to liberal states to lodge their discontent with lack of federal action but through, for example, legislation to expand the legal pathways for citizenship. And he is a strong supporter of reproductive rights at a time when congressional Republicans are considering legislation to restrict abortions nationwide.
Padilla’s challenger is Mark Meuser, a Republican constitutional lawyer whose positions don’t reflect the views and interests of Californians. Meuser supported the Supreme Court’s overturning of Roe vs. Wade and is highly critical of the state’s clean energy mandates. He didn’t support the Inflation Reduction Act, which will make a historic investment in fighting climate change, and is likely to vote with the GOP on any issue, no matter whether those policies run counter to the values of most Californians.
Californians deserve a senator who truly supports their ideals and is working to make the nation and its democracy stronger. We have one in Alex Padilla.
* * *
_Alex Padilla is the proud son of immigrants and a proud son of California. He’s fighting in the Senate to defend democracy and the right to vote, protect our environment, guarantee the right to an abortion, and uplift working families._
[**_If you can, please make a donation to Alex’s 100% people-powered campaign today >>>_**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22.YTGLMp&refcode=em221004-1-30&t=2&akid=1047%2E159979%2EUVepP4)
**[DONATE](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22.YTGLMp&refcode=em221004-1-30&t=3&akid=1047%2E159979%2EUVepP4)**

| | Dear Friends:I've recently been to the Patriot's Mingles speaking event and heard Nick Morris speak on Election Integrity.If you wish to have your voice heard through your ballot, do not vote until Election Day, November 8th. Bring in the mailed in ballot to your Registrar of Voters station, tell them you want a new ballot printed (not a provisional) and then write SURRENDER on your mailed in ballot and tear it up and hand it to them. Yes, things have gotten extreme. But if we can get some Constitutional Representatives in office, we may still be able to turn our beautiful California around.Meanwhile, get all the info you can on what you can do.-Help a candidate canvass, put their sign in your yard.-Tell your friends and family members about them- email and call them as well to get the word out on who the real candidates are who are worthy of your vote.That's what me and my team are doing! We have been canvassing for Peter Hernandez, Congressional Candidate for District 18! And we are helping 3 local schoolboard candidates. I also have my podcast up and running. Comes out every Monday about the globalization of America, and the world.You can't fight what's happening unless you know what's going on! body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51964515/370861933/-1752180686?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NGVkMjY0ZS0zMTQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d0YP5Mh_P8r73Jaxlld4HQQUHIzEbpEQpKjTKpc105I=)
Peter,

Last night, Eric took the debate stage across from Esther King for the first time.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51964517/370861936/-396165772?refcode=em-10.4.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NGVkMjY0ZS0zMTQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d0YP5Mh_P8r73Jaxlld4HQQUHIzEbpEQpKjTKpc105I=)
Our goal was simple: make a clear case for why Eric should be elected to serve this community. I joined Eric's campaign knowing this was about bringing people together to solve the real issues impacting Illinois families. This is about our ability to afford care, retire with dignity, put our kids through school, and live in an environment with clean air to breathe and water to drink.

**Eric knocked it out of the park, and the contrast against Esther King's was quite stark. She doubled down on her anti-choice position, and didn't have an answer as to why she's being bankrolled by Kevin McCarthy's super PAC.**

If you didn't know this, King isn't even originally from the 17th district, so it's no wonder she's so out of touch. My favorite point in the debate was when King rattled off the names of some of the bigger cities in our district -- a bare minimum attempt at passing off as a local. Eric quickly retorted with the names of even more (and even smaller) towns like Prophetstown, Lanark, Knoxville, and Canton -- _places King's probably never campaigned in._

[**We think what Eric said last night connected with those in attendance. And we hope we made you a proud supporter, too. If you're with us, please send in a donation of $3 or more today. We're still contending with McCarthy's super PAC and every bit helps in the homestretch.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51964521/370861939/-396165772?refcode=em-10.4.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NGVkMjY0ZS0zMTQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d0YP5Mh_P8r73Jaxlld4HQQUHIzEbpEQpKjTKpc105I=)

Thanks, Peter. More soon.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Climate change isn’t a future problem
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
#
Peter,
Over the past few weeks, we’ve seen tropical storms causing catastrophe across North America — from Hurricane Fiona in Puerto Rico to Hurricane Ian in Florida.
And climate disasters like Hurricane Fiona and Hurricane Ian will only become more common if we don’t take bold action to build on the progress made with the Inflation Reduction Act.
Future generations are looking to us to act. We must — for their sake and ours.
As chair of the Progressive Caucus in Congress, I will always fight for the climate action that will be necessary if we’re going to address this crisis. [**Will you pitch in with a donation of $3 or more to help us in this fight?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16153?c0=20221004.CiJy4e&refcode=em20221004-1679&t=1&akid=1679%2E420207%2EZ7AVye)

Peter, earlier this year, Congress passed the Inflation Reduction Act, which will cut carbon pollution by 40% by 2030. This was a historic piece of climate legislation, but we can’t stop there.
Hurricanes and wildfires are getting stronger. Droughts are getting longer. Sea levels are rising. Things are getting worse.
We need BOLD climate action now. But in order to stand up to fossil fuel companies, their lobbyists, and their corporate PACs, it will take a movement of us working together.
[**Peter, can you chip in $3 — or whatever amount feels meaningful to you — to support our advocacy to fight the climate crisis?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16153?c0=20221004.CiJy4e&refcode=em20221004-1679&t=21&akid=1679%2E420207%2EZ7AVye)
Thank you for being in this fight,
Pramila

## County Board Vote Ends Political Smear Campaign of Supervisor Tom Patti
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA – Politics can get dirty, but Josh Harder and his political allies have taken it to a new level with a "fact-free" smear campaign of San Joaquin County Supervisor Tom Patti.

Unfortunately for Harder, his fictional storyline blew up today when the Board of Supervisors overwhelmingly rejected a politically motivated report designed to smear Patti and derail his surging campaign by voting not to censure Patti. Patti's attorney informed the Board, "the investigation violated Patti's due process rights."

None of the witnesses cited in the repot were under oath, and virtually everything in the report was hearsay. Most strikingly, the investigator never even interviewed Tom Patti. Nonetheless, at least one Supervisor, for obvious political motives, sought to censure Patti based solely on the manufactured accusations, which would have been a clear violation of basic due process rights.

"I am glad that the Board saw this for what is was: a political hit job designed to benefit my opponent Josh Harder," Patti said. "Their political stunt failed. Now maybe we can talk about the real issues affecting San Joaquin County residents - rising crime, rampant homelessness and crushing inflation."

The political nature of the attack could not have been more obvious. Almost immediately after the sham accusations were made, Harder put up a billboard declaring, "Supervisor Tom Patti Under Investigation for Bribery."

"Harder has no shame, but fortunately the truth usually wins out in the end," Patti said. "The allegation of bribery stemmed from Josh Harder's team, but it was found unsubstantiated by the investigator. Shame on Josh Harder for lying to voters and wasting taxpayer dollars on a sham investigation that he knew was false on day one."

"Josh Harder owes me, my family, and San Joaquin taxpayers an apology," Patti concluded.

Unfortunately, this isn't the first time Josh Harder has been caught lying to voters. Just last week, the Sacramento Bee called Harder out for his claims that Patti voted to increase the gas tax. Per their "fact check," The Sac Bee rightfully noted that the gas tax was passed by the California legislature, which is controlled by Democrats. As a sitting Supervisor in Joaquin County, Patti would have never had the authority to vote for such a bill. Voters need to be aware that Josh Harder will say anything to get elected.
---
|
---
| **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

Nonetheless, at least one Supervisor, for obvious political motives, sought to censure Patti based solely on the manufactured accusations, which would have been a clear violation of basic due process rights. "I am glad that the Board saw this for what is was: a political hit job designed to benefit my opponent Josh Harder," Patti said. "Their political stunt failed. Now maybe we can talk about the real issues affecting San Joaquin County residents - rising crime, rampant homelessness and crushing inflation." The political nature of the attack could not have been more obvious. Almost immediately after the sham accusations were made, Harder put up a billboard declaring, "Supervisor Tom Patti Under Investigation for Bribery." "Harder has no shame, but fortunately the truth usually wins out in the end," Patti said. "The allegation of bribery stemmed from Josh Harder's team, but it was found unsubstantiated by the investigator. Shame on Josh Harder for lying to voters and wasting taxpayer dollars on a sham investigation that he knew was false on day one." "Josh Harder owes me, my family, and San Joaquin taxpayers an apology," Patti concluded. Unfortunately, this isn't the first time Josh Harder has been caught lying to voters. Just last week, the Sacramento Bee called Harder out for his claims that Patti voted to increase the gas tax. Per their "fact check," The Sac Bee rightfully noted that the gas tax was passed by the California legislature, which is controlled by Democrats. As a sitting Supervisor in Joaquin County, Patti would have never had the authority to vote for such a bill. Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501791:6w3NbXVN2:m:1:3317145305:465D83AC4385F27C63C44395D2C7BD11:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61501791:6w3NbXVN2:m:1:3317145305:465D83AC4385F27C63C44395D2C7BD11:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

Peter,

The Real Clear Politics polling average has me behind by 0.3% in the Georgia Senate race with less than 6 weeks until the election.

Since more than $50 million has been spent against me in false attack ads, it's remarkable that this race is as close as it is - and _it speaks volumes about how disillusioned Georgians are with Democrats._

are you with me?

| Friend,

Our country has become a disaster. The Left has picked apart our core little by little, weakening us on the internal stage.

Peter, Year after year, Republicans in the state legislature introduce bills that chip away at our reproductive rights. If they have their way, Florida will have among the **most restrictive abortion laws in the country** — until they achieve their ultimate goal of banning abortion outright.

**[We need you to help protect abortion access in Florida. Sign our petition: Demand Florida legislators reject all abortion bans and restrictrions.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51966819/370870107/-423532860?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzE1NjM5IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhiMjUxYjA3LTM5NDQtZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gZknBGTI7rNWKKubsheGTN9i71s4N5_ML5t3Fumu1Ok=&emci=5f0d823b-0a23-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=8b251b07-3944-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=2292877) **

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Hi,
We checked our records and it looks like you didn’t make a donation this past quarter.
[If you are able to donate, but didn’t get around to it, you can still make a gift here.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221004.6Iq8Uy&refcode=em20221004-3467-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3467%2E2526796%2EsK7PLE) But if you aren’t convinced why your donation is needed right now or what it will accomplish – **please give us a moment to explain why your donation is so important.**
_We know that times are tough and that not everyone is in a place to give, so if that’s you – we understand and, if you have the time, we hope you’ll consider[**signing up to volunteer**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14951?t=3&akid=3467%2E2526796%2EsK7PLE) with our campaign instead._
_**Reason 1: We rely entirely on you.**_
Our campaign takes **0** corporate donations. There’s no super PAC or big donor coming in to protect us from the attacks constantly coming our way. So if our donations drop, as they have been starting to lately, we will have to reassess our budget and make tough cuts.
_**Reason 2: Our last election was the second most expensive House race in the country.**_
Our last Republican challenger in 2020 raised $10 million. And we can’t let those attacks go unanswered because they could chip away at the credibility of the Congresswoman and her policies, even if they aren’t initially successful in kicking her out of office. So we are still very much in campaign mode. We still have to pay for expensive radio and digital ads, and we are running a field program that stretches across two boroughs.
_**Reason 3: We organize a lot of community-building programs, outside of traditional election work.**_
We aren’t a traditional campaign, and we know that’s part of why you’re here. During the pandemic, we ran a food distribution program that lasted for over a year. We organized a Census outreach program in 2020 that helped New Yorkers keep a congressional seat. We run a Homework Helpers program that tutors students in our district. And last weekend, we gave out thousands of backpacks to support families going back to school. **But to keep doing untraditional work like this, we need to keep our budget strong.**
[We know you can make a donation a lot of places, particularly this election season. But we hope we’ve explained why we also need you to keep giving here – even if it’s small. Can you chip in $3 today to help our campaign going strong? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221004.6Iq8Uy&refcode=em20221004-3467-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3467%2E2526796%2EsK7PLE)

From all of us here on the campaign, we thank you for your continued support.
Team AOC

clean_body: We checked our records and it looks like you didn’t make a donation this quarter. Hi, We checked our records and it looks like you didn’t make a donation this past quarter. But if you aren’t convinced why your donation is needed right now or what it will accomplish – please give us a moment to explain why your donation is so important. We know that times are tough and that not everyone is in a place to give, so if that’s you – we understand and, if you have the time, we hope you’ll consider with our campaign instead. Reason 1: We rely entirely on you. Our campaign takes 0 corporate donations. There’s no super PAC or big donor coming in to protect us from the attacks constantly coming our way. So if our donations drop, as they have been starting to lately, we will have to reassess our budget and make tough cuts. Reason 2: Our last election was the second most expensive House race in the country. Our last Republican challenger in 2020 raised $10 million. And we can’t let those attacks go unanswered because they could chip away at the credibility of the Congresswoman and her policies, even if they aren’t initially successful in kicking her out of office. So we are still very much in campaign mode. We still have to pay for expensive radio and digital ads, and we are running a field program that stretches across two boroughs. Reason 3: We organize a lot of community-building programs, outside of traditional election work. We aren’t a traditional campaign, and we know that’s part of why you’re here. During the pandemic, we ran a food distribution program that lasted for over a year. We organized a Census outreach program in 2020 that helped New Yorkers keep a congressional seat. We run a Homework Helpers program that tutors students in our district. And last weekend, we gave out thousands of backpacks to support families going back to school. But to keep doing untraditional work like this, we need to keep our budget strong. From all of us here on the campaign, we thank you for your continued support. _But when she reveled how she has NO plan to help Virginians through inflation, I was floored._

**When your constituents are****struggling, “sorry” just isn’t going to cut it.**

clean_body: | | | Peter, During last night’s debate against Jennifer Wexton, I heard a lot of shocking things. But when she reveled how she has NO plan to help Virginians through inflation, I was floored. I’ll let you see what she said for yourself: “It's going to be tough sledding from here on out and we are sorry about that.” When your constituents arestruggling, “sorry” just isn’t going to cut it. Unlike Jennifer Wexton, I have a plan: cut back on socialist spending, reduce red tape, and support the small businesses that keep our economy strong. As a Navy Officer, I never went into a mission without a plan, Peter. I knew how much was on the line, and I wasn’t just going to “wing it.” But with millions of livelihoods at risk, that’s exactly what Jennifer Wexton is doing.
